Dr. LaPlant is one of the best professors I have ever worked with. She's extremely knowledgable in her field and loves to teach. Highly, highly recommend.

Dr. Madigan loves what he does and is extremely passionate. There is SO MUCH READING to do so be ready to read. He grades toughly on papers. There are quizzes after books, so reading is mandatory. As long as you read and participate you will pass.

comment: He's a nice person, there was a lot of reading but the books he chose were interesting and good reads. Best. Professor. Ever.

First of all Corinne is a great person and very personable. Corinne was such a great professor, especially as a first year student. She's very passionate about religion and that makes it easier and more fun. There are only 4 or 5 Quizs and then a midterm and a final. shes the best.  literally so fun and interesting. She makes you like what youre learning about

This class was so interesting and mind opening. Corinne is one of the nicest most caring people I have ever met. Everyone should take this class as long as you have an open mind toward religious experience.

Professor Mitchell is amazing.  She wants to see her students succeed and is always willing to meet with her students when they need.

Dr. Mitchell is WONDERFUL. She is without a doubt the most intelligent yet down to earth person I have ever had the privilege of learning from. This class was so interesting and I discovered a love for graphic novels through it. 2 papers, 5 fun page analyses, a presentation, and a final!

She is super nice. There are 3 papers the whole semester. The lecture and class itself are super boring but an easy A if you don't miss more than 3 classes. However, this class really taught me how to write proper college essays. If you struggle with essays this is the class to take!

comment: Dr. Mitchell is the best professor in the English Department. She is clear and consise in her assignments, helpful in her individual meetings, and informative in her lectures. She is truly great at her job and really cares for her students. All other professors should take notes from Dr. Mitchell.

She does assign a lot of reading for homework, but she's worth it!

Dr. Mitchell is the gem of the English Department here at Nazareth, and if you have an opportunity to take a class with her, TAKE IT! She's the best!

I love Dr. Mitchell, she is so passionate when she teaches and will always go out of her way to make sure you understand the material she is teaching and is always available for help! You may have to work for your grade in her classes, but you really do learn a lot from her and it's worth it!!

Super nice! Always available for help!! Gives great feedback. Gives you class time to work on assignments. Very understanding. I enjoyed the class.
Dr. Mitchell is a great teacher. She is very helpful and she tells you what she expects of you. Sort of a tough grader, but if you really put in effort you will get a good grade.
I loved Adrielle! She made class very interesting and I even enjoyed the material! I would recommend her to anyone in a minute!

Dr. Mitchell is easily one of the most brilliant professors I've had while studying at Nazareth. I loved her class, though she did expect a lot of us. I thought the course was a bit heavy with the readings, but honestly, I feel like I got so much out of it. She was very flexible with extensions too, which is nice.

This was the class I dreaded taking the most because English is not my friend and as a Bio major who cares anyway.  But it's actually my most useful class this semester and I think because we practiced incorporating evidence paraphrasing so early in the semester it paid off in my PEQ classes already.  Plus she changes it up so it doesn't drag.
Smart.  Fair.  Never boring.

This course was called Transmedia Adaptations which I didn't understand at first but then really enjoyed it.  It's a combined literature and media class and we read and watched all kinds of things and then talked abuot social media theory for the second half of the class.  Hard sometimes, but really interesting.  Wonderful professor.
She is very open-minded. She doesn't do anything that makes you feel uncomfortable! I enjoyed in particular when she focused linguistics during her classes!

I wish Dr. Mitchell were teaching more classes.  Now that she is chair of the department I keep looking for more classes from her and they're not there.  I know she is very busy but she's an amazing professor.

I just finished the final exam for Creative Non-fiction and even if I get a C in this class which I probably will, I think it was the most valuable class I've ever taken.  Strange new books, all different, like nothing i've ever read and podcasts that make you question the difference between fiction and fact.  Smart professor knows her stuff.
More than willing to work with those who want to succeed, but tough on grading.

One of the most brilliant professors and phenomenal people I have ever met.  She'll teach you how to question and how to think.  You'll walk away from her class a better, more open-minded human being.  Can't ask for more than that!
One of the best professors I have ever had.  I reccommend her for everyone.  She teaches the way all professors should.  You learn and have fun at the same time.
I think Dr. Mitchell is one of the few professors at Nazareth who actually make you actually think.  That's what I thought college was for.

Dr. Mitchell is an interesting professor.  I am not an English major and sometimes I felt that the work was too hard for a PII, but it was a challenge.  I got better at writing and reading hard books by the end of the semester.  Participate in discussion cause she gets jazzed up when people do and she can really respond and take it to a new level.

WHATEVER YOU DO YOU MUST TAKE GRAPHIC NARRATIVE!  IT'S THE MOST AMAZING CLASS EVER.  I DIDN'T EVEN KNOW THERE WERE BOOKS LIKE THIS AND THAT YOU COULD SAY SO MANY DIFFERENT THINGS ABOUT THEM.  NOW I WISH I MAJORED IN ART OR ENGLISH.
Sometimes I would think man where is she going with this and then it would all make sense.  Not the most linear of profs, but there wasn't a day I didn't learn something from her.

This is a good course for learning about writing better.  I didn't really want to have more english course but then when I did this teacher she make it very worth while.  I do better on my papers everywhere now, for two years, and I know how to revise.  She is a very good teacher.
Smokin and brilliant.
Dr. Mitchell is one of my favorite professor at Naz.  I like the readings although there were alot of them, and I felt challenged to think.  She is really clear and sometimes very interesting.
Dr. Mitchell is brilliant!  I am in awe.

I took two courses with Dr. Mitchell when I was a student at Nazareth and have to say she was one of my best professors there (and I wasn't even an English major).  Take a class with her if you get a chance; doesn't matter which one cause she makes it all really interesting and relevant.  She's not easy, but she really helps you think and write.

I am in Young Adult Literature too, and I think it is a great class.  The books are all so different, and we talk about things about society that are really important but that nobody talks about. This is a great class.  I wasn't even so sure I wanted to take it but I'm really glad I did.  We are reading all kinds of books, and it isn't only focused on women's issues. She is an excellent professor that certainly guided me on the right direction for my writing. She leaves her assignments open-ended so you can decide how to do them. 102 was a lot better though because we did a semester-long paper that was broken up nicely. I thought she was an amazing professor.
Love this professor. Makes more sense than most and isn't bad to look at, either.

Dr. Mitchell has become my favorite professor. She is intelligent and well-versed in both english and education topics. She teaches with ease, and takes an interest in her students. I wish I had the opportunity to take many more classes with her. It would be worth your while to take a class with her

I really like Dr. Mitchell.  She can be really funny, even when the material is suppposed to be dry and boring.  Too much reading maybe but that's always how it is in English.  Go see her on office hours, she really talks to you about whatever you need help with and she tells the truth.

This course has a lot of work (maybe too much for intro to women's studies) but it's great!  The best part is that Dr. Mitchell is not a feminazi AT ALL.  She shows you how theres a feminist theory for everything you could possibly think about.

She was very VERY nice during class and genuinely likes her students. She is willing to let anyone talk at anytime and loves to meet with students about papers. She even remembers your name 3 years after her class... :)
Very approachable.. Very nice, tried very hard to make it interesting

TAKE THIS CLASS!(Modern Poetry)  I was terrified of poetry coming into the class, but Dr. Mitchell made it interesting and exciting.  Tough (but fair) tests, interesting projects/papers.  One of the best courses i took at Naz.
Not too much work, kind of interesting, not so bad

I do not recommend taking a class with Dr. Stachowski if you don't have to.  Her testes are completely different from all the exams and practices tests she give you.  She seems to briefly touch on large topics and go into large detail of the things that don't matter much on the quizzes/exams/

Professor Stachowski is very knowledgeable in her field. Did not want to help students succeed at all

Worst teacher I have ever had. Does not care about actually teaching, anytime you ask her something she looks pissed off. Professor Banfield is amazing.  She wants to see her students succeed and as long as you follow her lectures and grading criteria you will do just that.
She is a great teacher. Lecture heavy but uses real life examples to make the topic to help stick better!

Prof. Banfield is a lovely person. You can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches and is great at explaining complex material. Professor Banfield has been one of my favorite professors. Dr. Foran is one of the most nice/kind people Ive ever met. His lectures were always interesting and he is really good at helping you during office hours as well. Dr. Foran is awesome! I really looked forward to attending this class. His lectures are funny and relevant, and you can tell he genuinely enjoys teaching and his subject area. He is a fair grader and allows you to revise or even re-revise your work.

Dr. Foran is the best professor I've ever had. He's hilarious and his lectures are always interesting. Fantastic professor. Hard grader, but is available for help. He strives to make you better and shows genuine concern.

He is my favorite professor in the English department. He is incredibly respectful and runs class well. He makes you work very hard, but will help you the whole way for you to achieve your goals.

Foran is an amazing English teacher. Everything was made extremely clear and the one on one paper conferences helped you improve your essays tremendously. All my questions about writing were answered throughout the semester. He's overall a great teacher and person.

LOVE LOVE LOVED him. There are no test, your grade is based off of the papers you write. No final exam, just a final paper that was pretty much putting together everything you learned over the year. Dr. Foran, is a gifted literature Professor. He is a rare Professor that you cannot help but learn and in an intelligent interesting way. Professor is nice as a person but as a professor he's not very effective in teaching atleast in my opinion.

Quite possibly the best college professor I've encountered in my whole educational experience. He will do anything to ensure his students success. Every semester I make sure to take a class with him, even if I don't have to. Definitely take his class!

Cappon is a great professor and I would absolutely reccomend! His lectures are amusing and he is always willing to answer questions. His lab reports are very straight forward, and as long as you attend class, you will pass very easily.
Best lab section professor, straight forward and willing to work with you.

does not give eye contact

funny, is not clear enough sometimes

comment: The best guy you can have for lab. Hilarious and never fails to make you laugh. Doesn't make eye contact.

Dr. Brooks is a stellar prof. Intelligent, humble, accessible, and kind - I cannot recommend her enough. Dr. Brooks is an amazing professor she explains information really well and is accessible outside of class and is always down to stay after and answer questions I would definitely recommend her as a professor.

Dr. Brooks is an awesome professor. She is personable and makes you want to learn the material. She relates it all back around and really reinforces concepts. love this man dearly hes passionate about what he does and it shows. he doesnt take attendance either. but his class is very easy

Professor O'Loughlin is a nice enough guy; however, his teaching skills are horrendous. the professor is rude when asked questions and will not explain things during office hours which were talked about in the notes. he also claimed that we would need a guinness while figuring out his class even though most students are underaged.

The class was interesting, but he is not the best at explaining. He starts out his thoughts and then gets lost halfway through them and never fully explains what he means, which can be super frustrating and confusing. His homework and lab assignments do not have clear instructions and he is pretty harsh with grading. Very picky.

Amazing professor, knew what he was talking about, and answered questions thoroughly which was helpful. However, he is an EXTREMELY hard grader. The MC on tests contain questions/answers that are vague. The course itself was interesting but I'm unsure if I'd take another class with him only because of how he grades tests and writing assignments.

This man is the harshest grader I've ever had. He doesn't give clear instructions for homework assignments. His multiple choice questions are extremely vague. He says he is available to help students outside of class, but when you meet with him he acts annoyed for you not understand everything. 0/10, would not recommend to a friend.

He's an intelligent man, but this class is a nightmare. It's stats... with NO MATH. He attempts to explain everything, but without doing it by hand, it is almost impossible to understand. There are three tests and one paper that are graded, so that isn't much help. He says he is available to help, but even if you go to him he still grades so harsh.

Dr. O'Loughlin's lectures were very interesting and I was never bored in the class. If you study the powerpoints for the test, you can receive a very high grade. They were very fair. Although I did well on the papers, many people I talked to struggled with them. It is best to go into his office hours and chat with him about your papers.

Dr. O'Loughlin is very knowledgable in the field of Abnormal Psychology. Get ready for profanity because he tends to swear a lot during lecture. He has a good sense of humor, and if you ask a question, he answers with a clear response. It's best if you read ahead, but his lectures go along well with the textbook. I would recommend this professor.
His class had a very interesting subject matter. As long as you keep up with your work and try hard on assignments, you should be ok.

Great professor. I found him to be very helpful, he covers all of the content well and gives powerpoints for everything. Tests are a little difficult but fair. Also let me take an exam early so that I didn't miss my bus home for break. Very flexible.

I though professor O'Loughlin was a great person, depsite the comments below. He allowed me to take the final at a different date, after a death in my immediate family. Although the class consists of a lot of subject material, he presents you with slides of everything you will need to know for the tests, and if you take notes, you will be golden.

He is definitely not everyone's cup of tea. I really enjoyed his class. He is very no nonsense, if you do the work and put in the effort you'll do well simple as that. Some people dislike him because he is the professor you were warned about in high school: he doesn't care about your excuses and expects a high level of work.
I have taken classes with Dr. O'Loughlin (Social and Personality) and he is awesome. Funny and helpful. Some tests are hard but you just need to study. I plan to take Abnormal with him in the future

Worse professor I have ever met. While he did explain thE material well in class he never made himself available. In one class where we took a test and got done early he said he would stay the rest of the time incase we had questions on the paper and when a friend and I went Up to ask him a question he said he didn't have time to talk to us. Really

Not my favorite, at all. She is a very tough grader, unnecessarily so. There's also quizzes which are graded heavily. She also hovers around you... Some students are allowed opportunities to boost their grade and the criteria is confusing; It's never announced to the whole class, you just have to find out about it...and way too many group projects.

She was a really kind person, but I feel like her assignments were explained a lot more in depth than they had to be- she liked to use strong vocabulary for words that don't need it. I say this because when you read instructions for assignments from her, it will sound way more confusing than it needs to be. She's a nice person though, and can help.

Dr. Gentile is an amazing person, but a terrible professor. She will only grade your papers as met/revise, it is not until the end of the semester that you will receive a letter grade. Your midterm is a group project, and your final is another group project building off the first one.

comment: She's a wonderful professor who always finds interesting ways to engage us in learning. The content was mostly lecture and note-based with very little practical learning though, which I felt didn't benefit me as much as I thought it would.

Not a fan of ungrading, but she does give fairly detailed feedback about your work. Assignments were pretty easy if you're already a good writer, the self assessment forms took almost as long as the projects themselves. Variety in assignments, both essays and visual design projects, and one group project. Class isn't super interesting, but not bad.

Dr. Gentile is a great professor and always provides detailed feedback on assignments. Sometimes the lectures can be a little boring, however the content is rather easy to understand. She uses an unusual grading method where you won't know your actual number grade for a while. She uses your input to grade your assignments. I would recommend.
takes a long time to grade, but a super sweet professor and very understanding. you can talk to her about anything.

Professor Gentile has one of the most boring teaching styles ever. She talks all class in a monotone voice making it impossible to pay attention. The work is repetitive so much so that you ask yourself how the directions are any different from the last. Then she follows a "ungrading" policy which means she only gives a grade at the end of semester
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Gives good feedback', 'Lecture heavy']

comment: Professor Gentile talked the entire class and gave us 5 minutes to do the extremely detailed assignments she gave. On top of this, almost every unit required group work that was pointless and again wasted time. She had NO GRADING RUBRIC; this course was "self-graded" which really means that you don't know your grade until the end of the semester.

Literally love her, absolute angel. Very good teacher in general-her lectures are engaging and effective. She was also very understanding when I needed extensions or help with assignments. Highly recommend.

Gives detailed feedback and allows for revisions until the last day of the semester. Project and paper-based, no tests or quizzes. Uses "ungrading" method where you grade yourself and she takes that into consideration. The only downside of this is not knowing actual grade until after the semester ends, which I didn't like, but still recommend her.

She emails back very quick. Will always be willing to help you with any work. You can do revision till the end of the semester. Her grading system is based on mainly effort. TBH if you fail it is honestly your fault cuz she is always willing to help you and get you a better grade. She is chill

i loved this class! Although she can be a tough grader, she gives amazing feedback. She is a very caring and understanding prof. be prepared for a heavy workload at the start of the course but it will lighten up as you move through the semester.
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Accessible outside class', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: By far my favorite professor I have this semester. Super sweet, made lectures interesting, gave good feedback on drafts/proposals. Wish office hours were in person instead of zoom. Lots of readings but they were not too long. Definitely take a class with Dr. Gentile if you can. Only class I don't dread going to this semester lol.

She assigned a lot of reading for this class but when I wouldnt read one of the thee assigned passages and just do discussions or responses based on the others, I did great on those assignments Also all of the passages are genuinely so interesting Short recorded lectures Really forgiving on grading
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: She was an amazing professor. She gives great feedback and is very understanding. Your course load is very heavy at the beginning and lightens up a little towards the end of the semester.

Dr. Gentile is such a sweet Naz prof. This class is already designed to an online format, so that was really easy to do & understand. Though, I felt like the weekly courseload was too much - I think she could have divided it up a bit more. She grades pretty steeply & can be a bit confusing/lofty in her feedback. But she allows for final revisions!
She was a tough grader, but very sweet.
tags: ['Tough grader', 'Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework']

comment: Although I took this class online over a 5 week period, Dr. Gentile was very understanding of summer schedules and due dates. The course itself was a little content heavy and based mostly on written assignments, but she offers good feedback and a lot of opportunities to ask for help.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria', 'Gives good feedback']

comment: Overall a very nice lady but if you don't read the books she assigns you won't pass the class even. Everything including papers, in class writings, discussions, midterm and final is based off the books and a few in class notes. Its hard to understand and follow through with the class. There is in class grade writing almost every class so don't skip
tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass."]

comment: Dr. Gentile is incredible! She really made me think about the world around me and my view of it in this class. There are a lot of readings and class discussions, but they're all super interesting. 2 analysis papers that were a lot of fun to write, and a final project that can be anything you want it to be. I would definitely take this class again!
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'Clear grading criteria']

comment: The class is based heavily on the readings. You have either a reading response or a quiz every class. They aren't that bad as long as you read. She is heavily into discussions and short responses based on the readings. The class is centered around the readings, so don't take this class if you are not prepared to do the work.
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Get ready to read', 'SO MANY PAPERS']

comment: She's very passionate about what she does. There are in class worksheets that are graded typically on accuracy, but you could work with other people. All her tests were multiple choice. All her slides were posted, but I highly recommend going as there are fill in the blanks. There was little group work. She does offer extra credit.

Great prof for bio. Worksheets every class that you get a zero on if incomplete. Provided study material and past exams for tests. Just super lecture heavy. For lab, (Jensen) super strict grader on the reports.

Professor Ohira was nice. Her PowerPoints can be a little confusing at times. Tests were difficult but if you review the material and pay attention, you should be fine. Offers test corrections for exams, but no curve. Claims class isn't mandatory but frequently have in person worksheets that you will receive a zero if missed (can't make it up).
Professor is very passionate about what she teaches. She may seem tough at first but provides a lot of material to help you with this course.

Most online assignments were completion, in class practice problems were graded but easy and you could work with classmates. Class is entirely lecture, slides posted online. Take notes and review them, come to review classes or office hours, and the tests should be easy (multiple choice). Attendance is optional but I highly recommend going.
Ohira was a good teacher, class is very lecture heavy. She tell you what will be on your tests, and does allow test corrections. If you put the work into the class you should be fine.

She tries to intimidate students in the beginning by saying her class is really hard, but it was fine. If you show up, pay attention to lectures and study for exams, there is basically no reason why you should not pass. Highly recommend doing the practice tests before each one because she reused questions, and the final was also reused questions.

Dr. Ohira was an amazing professor. If you don't do the readings and don't attend lectures you will not be successful. She is very straightforward about what you need to know for tests and even gives review tests for exams. She provides test corrections which are awesome to help boost your grade. She is very passionate about what she teaches.

She was an ok teacher and her class wasn't really difficult, but she just seems to think a lot of herself and wasn't always there to help. She gives almost no extra credit and absolutely no late credit, so if you fall behind it can be difficult to catch up. She also just reads off the slides most of the time.

Dr. Ohira is really amazing. Her class is all lecture but she really emphasizes on what you need to know for tests and exams. She is so straight forward and usually gives you the questions and answers to tests on review sheets. A lot of work is needed to be put in, but she is good at helping guide you.

I loved Dr. Ohira's class. Her lectures were straight forward and everything you learned in class was on the exams. Her tests aren't difficult if you study. Definitely study the whole week before her exams. You had review days before the exam and most of the questions you reviewed in class were on the exam. She was so nice, take her class!!!

Dr. Steitz is one of the best professors I've ever had. He truly cares about his students and their needs. He eased a lot of my anxiety going into the final semester of my senior year. I highly recommend taking at least one class with him. I will miss him a lot!
Dr. Steitz was awesome, really enjoyed senior sem!

Dr. Steitz makes senior seminar such a laid back, enjoyable class. I genuinely looked forward to every class. He is very understanding, kind, and helpful, answering any and all of our questions about requirements, psych comp questions, and more. I could not recommend his senior sem more, you're missing out if you don't take it with him!
Super caring professor and truly wants to help his students
Engaging, fair, and genuinely cares about students' success and learning. Highly recommend I've learned so much
One of the most supportive professors I've had, truly a great person and teacher

DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASS. He may be super sweet on the surface, but deep down, this is an EVIL man (okay, I'm being a bit dramatic). Leaves you guessing on grades, very difficult exams, outrageous grade changes. Was not one bit helpful when I had issues with my final project. SAVE. YOURSELF.
tags: ['Group projects', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: Change asap. Terrible. I had a B as a midterm grade then when the final grade came out I received a D. He doesn't put grades in all year long so you have no idea what your grade is all semester long. Doesn't give back assignments for any of the exams. Don't recommend him at all.

I would not recommend. This professor does not like to put grades in and makes you calculate them yourself. Which in theory wouldn't be too bad, but he does not provide you with everything you've taken. He also lets your grading of your final project be completely random. My grade dropped from a B to a D when it should've still been a B still.

Overall, I think he is a nice guy. He can have a bit of an ego, but if you go to him for help, he will help you. The "Exams" for this class are difficult, but don't count for much of your grade. The only part that really matters is the final project. He will help you with this as much as you need which is really awesome.

I love Dr. Stetiz! He is very much a tough-love professor, and he doesn't tolerate anything but your best work. He gives amazing lectures and you can tell he has such a good understanding of the topics covered, and he does a great job at applying concepts to real world scenarios. He's a great guy, and wants what is best for his students.

change prof asap-will screw u over. I had an A as my midterm grade and then the end of the year I had a D. He never puts grades in the grade book so u dont know what your actual grade is. Gave me a 50 on my essay then gave a 97 on my presentation when my presentation was on my essay... extremely liberal and every lecture about his political views.

His class isn't lecture heavy and he prioritizes the final paper which isn't even that hard. He has no tests or quizzes, the only thing that is annoying are the current events, but they're done in class. I recommend him for people who want an easy psych class, but he is a douchebag so beware. He is so full of himself it's crazy.

Funny guy. Boring lectures but his rants are interesting. A few tests but not worth a lot. DO NOT BUY A TEXTBOOK. Grade is mainly based on research paper which is long and hard and awful but he is really helpful.
Hard grader, no extra credit given!

Final paper is majority of grade; gives research paper that one wouldn't write until methods class, if you are a psych major. Tests are 4% each. Participate and he will love you. Turn in many drafts of paper. Super nice, but kind of crazy.

Steitz gave off dictator vibes. He's nice but only if you speak at his level of what he thinks is right. I've had worse professors but definitely don't recommend if you are only taking one psych class.
Steitz is a great professor. He is a harsh grader, but he is fair in class and gives you the opportunity to change your grade.

He can seem pretty intimidating however he is very clear with what he expects from you as a student and is lenient with grading- on the huge research paper done throughout the semester you are allowed to send him drafts and he will give feedback on how you can do better. He can be pretty harsh in class but he wants to see his students succeed.

You'll learn almost nothing about psychology in Steitz's class other than how to deal with a professor on a power trip. It seems as if he goes out of his way to make his students embarrassed. Grading guidelines are unclear. If you think sending in multiple drafts of papers ensures you'll get the feedback needed to get a good grade, think again.

Professor Steitz is definently by far the WORST professor I have ever had. He hands out bad grades like candy to a child. Not that he would ever give candy to a child because he's a bad dude. He verbally disrespects students and creates an anxious, high pressured, taxing environment. Even when you try your best, its never good enough.

Steitz is one of those teachers that is either a hit or miss with students. If you just show up, take notes, and write deadlines down, you will do fine. People say daunting things about the course, but it really is not that bad and can be a bit fun sometimes. If you put forth effort, he will notice it and your grade will be glowing because of it:)

Overall okay. DO NOT SKIP CLASS AND PARTICIPATION IS IMPORTANT. Pay attention during class. If you are on zoom and he catches you it impacts your grade a ton. Graded by mainly tests, one big psych paper/ group project at the end of the semester, and participation. Willing to meet outside of class, clear grading criteria, and is a fair grader.
tags: ['Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Graded by few things']

comment: One of the worst professors Ive ever had. Just sits there while the students present all of the information to the class. He is inconsiderate and is not flexible for things even when they aren't your fault. Overall a bad dude and a bad teacher!

His material isn't hard hard, but he is just not very considerate. Wanted us to facilitate class lectures but then again he talks 80% of the time during them any ways. He also puts a lot of stress on you when things go wrong and it ISNT your fault. I've asked to meet with him, and have gotten the okay, and then chooses other students, not caring

Dr. Steitz is very nice and cares a lot about his students, although can seem to be tough at first he is always available to help you either in class time or outside of class. For his Psychology course, you write a paper and he is very tough on grading drafts, but he allows you to let him look it over how ever many times

I highly recommend not taking a class with professor Steitz. He had a lot of attitude in class and was willing to read drafts of students papers but made it seem like it was a bother to him. I barely learned anything about phsychology but learned a lot about APA format. Felt like I was taking an english course sometimes.

Steitz genuinely cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. He was more than willing to let students make corrections on paper drafts and listen to their input for tests. The class was less focused on learning psychology and more on writing a research paper but was great for skill-building.

He can be rude but this class is easy to pass if you work hard on the APA paper he gives. You need to bring him drafts of each section at least once before the due date and go to his office hours to get his feed back. He gives rubrics but always says more stuff in class that he wants and often there is even more that he wants so go to office hours.
tags: ["Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Group projects', 'Tough grader']

comment: Dr. Steitz is very knowledgeable about his subject. However, this class is an intro for core credit, & workload does not reflect that. He gives tests but they are barely weighted; the grade primarily comes from an APA group research paper that he grades very harshly almost solely on formatting, & is not incredibly understanding.

One of my favorite professors. His lectures are very interesting and he makes you want to do well in his class. Tough grader but only because he pushes you to be a better student. Participation is important.

I absolutely love him! His lectures are so interesting and he is very  passionate about psychology. Quizzes for each chapter were not difficult. He is a harsh grader in terms of essays. However, if you go to see him in office hours, he is so helpful and wants everyone to succeed!
Great professor

He is one of my favorite professors so far. He will help you as long as you go to office hours. you have a huge paper to write but you do it in sections throughout the semester and he will really help you if you want it.

Dr. Steitz can often come off as arrogant, but usually it is only taken that way by those he is smarter than. He has a very dry sense of humor and is very sarcastic, which flies over most people's heads. If you put in effort, you will do fine in the class and he will be willing to help you. If you do not put effort in, then his apathy is impressive

I would not recommend anyone to this professor. I've never met someone so ignorant and hypocritical. He rushes through lectures and his tests are so hard, I failed almost all of them. He cancels and lets class out early all of the time. Yes it is nice to not have class sometimes but I had a D in the class because I wasn't learning enough.
Wasn't a fan of the condescending nature of this professor. His class would be more enjoyable if he didn't make people feel like they were lesser or didn't deserve to be there.

Dr. Steitz is awesome. He was probably one of my top professors in the psych department. He is a really cool guy and is there to help you with anything. He actually cares about his students and wants everyone to succeed, but you have to work for it. I became a much better student and person because of him.

Great professor. He pushes you to go the extra mile in class to prepare you for the future in college. He was helpful with any questions. People don't seem to like him because he gave a lot of work, but this isn't high school anymore.

psychology is my major so i was excited to take this.. after a while, i found dr. steitz to be very arrogant, hypocritical and egotistical. he never fully explained what needed to be done for assignments and got angry when not done correctly. his tests has questions about every little detail from the book. i was very disappointed overall

Steitz is really awesome if you WANT to be studying what you are in his class. He may seem like he thinks he's better than everyone else but he is just trying to push you and make you understand that this is COLLEGE and you need to take responsibility for your learning. Great professor if you actually TRY or CARE. And he CARES about you too

Dr. Steitz is extremely arrogant and hypocritical. He thinks he is better than everyone else and expects you to go the extra mile in class.  He then refuses to help you outside of what is contractually required of him. Dr Steitz is a stain on an otherwise fantastic psych program at Nazareth.

Steitz is so arrogant it's not even funny. Everything he does I find fault with because I just don't like the man. Tests are tough. If you study your ass off they aren't the worst, but overall the amount of work for an intro class is a bit too much.
If yo just go to him and make the attempt to know him he will help you with anything.

The good: enthusiastic and pretty fun guy, pretty organized and the material isn't too difficult. The bad: tests are pretty tough because they're so specific and on everything in the textbook...he comes off pretty self-centered but I guess he grows on you, stubborn guy but overall not too bad.

Fair teacher, but has a phd and the idea that this makes him great. I enjoyed the class and power points are readily available. He tests off everything (ie text book class and your ability to apply material). He may at first seem inapproachable; however he is not at all and he is interested in your critiques of the class as long as they are reasona

Your grade is not so much based on knowledge of psychology as just work ethic.  You can get a 70 on all your exams and still get an A in the class because he gives extra credit opportunities out the hooha.  Also, you can win back points on exams by going to his office hours and just babbling until he extracts the answers you got wrong out of you.

Makes no attempt to connect with his students.  Lots of reading for his class.  Ridiculous amount of material covered on each class.  The only good thing is that he let us correct our tests and regrade them.

Extremely arrogant. Does not teach material, just talks at you. Grades are not performance based but comparative, meaning you only get an A if you write the best paper. Test material comes from every where (lecture, textbook, his imagination). I would avoid any class with this professor.

Good teacher- study hard, make good notes.  Don't miss class.  Papers are important.  Like most Naz Professors is not going to accept anything that doesn't have a documented source for materials.  APA is very important, but you don't get any help other than what is in the book.
Serious and excited by material, but he isn't a very friendly or approachable kind of guy. For him attendance is everything.
A good teacher.  Likes to use gadgets in class to collect input from students.  Very serious about the topic.
No Comments

The rubrics for the essays were hard to understand and his expectations for assignments aren't clear. There were 2 major group projects that were a ridiculous amount of work to be completed in very little time. He doesn't give grades until the end of the semester and you have no idea what assignments are graded or not.  He's very nice though
Very nice and understanding professor. Class was usually pretty easy and there were not a ton of assignments, just a few essays and presentations.

professor C is an amazing professor, as long as you pay attention you'll completely fine. There was a few classes that where very lecture heavy with him just speaking to us and it was easy to zone out. He was very accessible outside of class, we had a few very insightful and helpful conversations.
tags: ['Lecture heavy', 'Graded by few things', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: Professor C really cares about his students.  There are only 3 essays that you have to write and the grading guidelines are very clear for all of them.  So classes can be a little more on the boring side but all the information is relevant to the essays you have to write so it is important to pay attention.
Class was super easy and clearly states what he wants in each paper. Also gives good feedback on each paper.
Overall a pretty chill professor. Very flexible and understanding.
Only 3 essays that go for a grade all semester, as long as you turn everything on time and follow the rubrics he is a pretty easy grader
this class was so fun and made me feel a lot more confident in writing. professor capossere is great i WISH i could take this class every semester
Capossere is a chill professor. He doesn't have tests nor quizzes. Very easy course just turn in essays on time and you'll do just fine. He is great with communication.

I highly reccomend him for anyone taking expostion and argument and research for the required english peqs. He is a easy grader, he has only ever given 5 C grades and one student failed because they didnt go to class. He is also a very good teacher and u will learn alot if you choose to. The essays have 3 drafts and only the final one gets graded

This class was great and she was very helpful. She never moved on without making sure everyone understood the material. Very accessible outside of class and was always willing to make time to help. Homework is harder than quizzes/test and it makes test/quiz feel easy. Great professor!

Professor Lause is an AMAZING professor and teacher. The class is very easy if you are good at thinking outside of the box (not me lol). It isn't your typical math class because it is SIGNIFICANTLY EASIER!! As long as you get your work done this will be a very easy A for you. She is one of the most considerate teachers! WOULD TOTALLY RECOMMEND!!

Dr. McCartney was wonderful when I had him. I had only had a class or two prior with him. However, when I applied to do my PhD, he'd talk to me about the different stages. He hyped me up during interviews. He gave advice about what to focus on later. He's still learning, but he wants to learn from you. One of the best profs I had at Naz

Love Dr. McCartney! Super nice guy, available for help outside of class. TBH I loved the material in this course, so I found it very easy. You do not need the textbook for this class, even though it is "required." Everything on the tests is in the lectures, so go to class. Good sense of humor, also he loves snakes.

Pretty basic class structure, bought the textbook but never used it, all info you're tested on comes from the slides (which are posted). Sometimes he would go more in depth than the slide, plus in class activities are graded on completion, so go to class. Final was a normal test. Nice guy, could tell it wasn't his specialty, but he did a good job.

While the course was extremely difficult, he made the content of his Fundamentals of Anatomy and Physiology course easy enough for non-majors to understand. He was clear and concise about the course content and demonstrated understanding if students were unclear about the subject matter. He gave opportunities for extra credit and was personable.

Although she is a tough grader she is very understanding. From the beginning of the semester I met with her during office hours and would ask questions during class. Also during tests and quizzes they are open notes and if you ask her a question she tells you the answers.
Dr. Boyd is very nice, but lectures were not very meaningful or helpful for the class. However, the class was pretty easy and did not require much work at all outside of class to do well.

She has no grading criteria and grades based on her opinion of you. Once you speak up once you no longer are graded fairly. She is incredibly difficult to work with and never answers the question head on there is always a 20 minute explanation to your question and by the end you forget what you asked her. There's no real class ever too.

She is very kind but not the best professor. She doesn't lecture, so be prepared to teach yourself. I have heard that she explains concepts better during office hours, if you have time to attend them. One of her exam outlines didn't end up matching the exam, which was pretty frustrating.

Absolutely terrible. Gave homework every class, and the grade on the homework goes towards the grade, but she will not grade and give feedback until the very last second. She is also just extremely boring, she's nearly inaudible, and I learned nothing. The only time I could tolerate being in her class is when I ate an edible and greened out.

Professor Boyd really does try to teach, but cannot get the concepts through. We had a quiz once a week on topics we barely learned about. The project throughout the class isn't horrible and she is available for office hours if needed and will help you a lot in them. doesn't have clear grading rubric,will mark off points for wrong spelled words.

She is very kind and wants her students to succeed however she is very difficult to actually learn from. She mumbles a lot, most of the time you can't really understand what she's saying. She tries to lecture but she doesn't know how. You will end up having to teach yourself most of the material. She was available for office hours which helps.
tags: ['Tough grader', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: Absolutely awful professor and class. Takes forever to put grades in and never helps you understand what your actually doing in class. Tries to lecture but never actually teaches.

Can't say I agree with these other reviews.  Dr. Boyd is very clear on her grading criteria, specifically in MTH 102, and explains the material well, oftentimes showing examples for solutions.  MTH 102 is full of many brain-teaser-like problems and group work where we have the ability to run our answers through with other students.

Overall, I would not recommend this professor. While she is friendly, she struggles to clearly explain the material, and much of what is covered in class is not well demonstrated. It's possible to succeed in the course, but it largely requires teaching yourself outside of class.

Primus is a knowledgeable individual of the field of social work. But, Primus is not a good teacher. I do not think teaching is for everyone. I really enjoy taking classes with Primus. He's passionate about what he teaches and is clearly super knowledgeable and experienced. He's kind, patient and has an overall calming demeanor. Primus is an amazing teacher and I absolutely loved his class. Interesting content and engaging discussions that I love to participate and listen to. Fantastic teacher and class, would highly suggest taking class with him.

This professor is pathetic. He doesnt create his syllabus or due dates so he isnt aware when stuff is due. He takes nearly over a month to grade reflections. comment: I had Primus last semester and was not a fan. Got the impression that he really didn't want to be there (I think he was sick?) This semester, it is like night and day. Awful. Avoid if at all possible. Rushes through everything. Assignments unclear. Grades assignments weeks after due date. Not helpful outside of class.

Primus is a great teacher, even though he spends majority of the time talking in front of the class, the information usually sticks.  I learned a lot of information from him that I have applied for my internships.

This guy is useless! don't take any classes from him. He teaches nothing and stands in front of the class asking any questions anybody, anybody a hundred times... Guy is an idiot!

Does not give feedback or grade assignment until the last week of class. Does not respond to emails. You will have no way of knowing how to improve in his class because of his lack of grading. Very poor teacher.

This class appears easy from the syllabus, but he doesn't actually teach his content. He reads off lecture notes that he provides but there is no homework so you must memorize 14 chapters for 4 tests the entire semester

Does not actually teach you anything, just reads off his 30+ page of notes per chapter. Highlights everything as well on them, therefore there is too much info to learn per chapter. Sometimes lectures and notes didn't match test questions. Lectures were long and the professor seemed uninterested in teaching.

The content isn't difficult if you're a health related major. (I am not) But he has a lazy attitude and teaching style. He grades lazily and doesn't update his content if he changes the tests. Extremely frustrating, made things hard due to lack of planning.

I crammed and ended up being fine but I know a lot of people didn't so STUDY! He's really specific about everything you hand in being formatted perfectly and everything being on time. I am taking his class for nutrition, and he just reads off of his board. He doesn't have office hours, we have to go to him for office hours either before or after class. Compared to the other A&P professors I really like Doyle. He wants us to succeed and pass his class. I enjoyed his lecture notes because they provided all the info you needed. They aren't typical lecture slides but I found them really helpful. If you can get Doyle for bio or A&P courses definitely do it.

I am taking Doyle for Anatomy and Physiology I during the Summer A semester, and I am doing well in the class, but I do not recommend him as a professor. Professor Doyle was not the best teacher. He read notes off of one long word document which personally isn't my learning style. The lectures are just him talking for a straight hour which doesn't help. The lecture notes are way too long and states the important stuff is highlighted in red, but the whole damn page is red. Dr. Doyle is the worst professor I have had at Naz. He does not answer emails, or want to meet with students. Class started late and/or ended early too many times in the semester. Doesn't teach. Doesn't make powerpoints, notes, or tests. NO extra credit. Tests you on stuff you haven't learned or had the ability to learn. Adds random tests online and doesn't acknowledge them. Does not respond to emails. Completely unhelpful, and should not be a teacher.

The absolute WORST professor I have EVER had. He is rude to his students and will not make accommodations for those that need it. For your sanity, DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM.

For a class full of non-science majors, this professor dives way too deep into course material. Dr. Doyle is one of the best professors to have for anatomy lab. Compared to other professors in this department he grades very fairly which can help your grade since anatomy is so hard.  Although he does not make the tests, he does try hard to tell you what has been on them in the past, and what might be asked.

I personally believe that he is more of a review professor. He reads straight from his notes and you could miss class and read the notes and not miss a thing. I'm not saying he doesn't know the content, he does, but I would not take this class with this professor if you are learning anatomy for the first time. Again, this is  my personal opinion...

People often say that he doesn't know enough about the subject, but to be a teacher in a subject with this much material, he definitely knows a lot! Don't complain, because you don't want the teacher who knows everything. Their being more prepared makes their class harder. He understands that he should focus on the basics and not overwhelm us.
She was a great professor. This was a hybrid course so we only had class Monday and Wednesday. A lot of team projects but nothing super hard or strenuous.

Dr. Hair is super kind and cares about her students, there is a lot of group work but it's very easy. It's a lot of lectures but they're all posted and not super important. Some homework assigned but it's mostly personality quizzes and very self explanatory.

Overall a super chill class and Dr. Hair is a really sweet lady. As a business minor, I found the course rather dull; the lectures are quite boring. There's barely any homework or assignments. She is one of the best professors that I've ever had! I had some health issues half way through the course, which made me miss some of the class, but she was extremely understanding and willing to help. Dr. Hair's class had some project work, but it was pretty easy as long as your group did what they were supposed to do. Would totally recommend!

Ignore every other rating on Dr Hair. Obviously it depends on what class you are taking, but I was in her teamwork and collab class and we did not even have a single assignment until 6 weeks into the semester. The only real assignment we were given was a 3 page essay on teamwork lol. If you want free credits, take a class with her.
Rose Hair is a wonderful professor. She allows students to be creative and work in groups. I love her slide memes. I would recommend this class for any business majors.

You may die of boredom. Excessive group work to compensate for lack of actual teaching. When there are lectures they are done from textbook ppt's. Get ready to hand in assignments daily on god knows what. Btw you'll never get graded on most of those. Good luck.
She's awesome!

Dr. Hair is a nice person to deal with.  Very understanding and willing to help you.  That being said, this class is awful.  Death by PowerPoint, everything is taught in a list. Mandatory attendance to have textbook publisher slides read to you, nearly verbatim. The amount of work assigned does not correlate to the importance of the material. AVOID

This professor has given us the exact quiz material, word for word, a week before the actual quiz every single time. If you pay attention and take notes in class you are pretty much guaranteed to get at least an A-.  It is listed that you need text books for this class but with that said I read the first 2-3 homework and never did another one.

Dr. Samz is very knowledgeable and I LOVED her methods of teaching. Her lectures were very easy to follow and take notes on. There were weekly quizzes and exact quiz questions were given in advance. Quizzes/tests align perfectly with lectures. Class has a midterm, final, and a final presentation.

Dr. Samz is an angel - so so sweet. Phl-391 was so easy if you pay attention, take notes, met with her, and study. You get the exam questions a week in advance, she walks you through the material - you dont need to ready. Clear on what is import. Lowkey made me like ethics

Dr. Samz is an amazing professor. She always goes over everything in great detail in a way you can understand without using big words that no one knows. Although she tells you to read you honestly don't need to since she goes over it all in class. Although she is quiz heavy she gives you the questions in advance.

She is one of my favorite professors at Naz. She tells you to read outside of class but she goes over the readings all on the board where everyone takes notes. She is a great professor. I rarely had to study outside of class, and if I did it would only take me 10 minutes. I definitely recommend her to anyone taking philosophy.

Professor Samz is very knowledgeable and caring, for her class its typically a lecture everyday and sometimes has you participate at the end and do a couple exercises from the book. The only bad thing was you take 6 quizzes and a final and then theres nothing to boost your grade if quizzes arent your strong suit. It felt like you either pass or not

Dr. Samz is a very kind and helpful professor- answers emails quickly. QUIZZES/TESTS ARE ALL MEMORIZATION! Notes gone over in class can be put directly onto study guides (she gives the exact questions that will be on tests/quizzes). Show up to class and take notes, bullet out answers while studying, and do the practice logic exercises she provides!

Samz's grades relies heavily on lectures and quizzes. In fact, 90% of the grades are from quizzes. But she posts all of the questions a week in advance so it's easy to get 100 if you study. But she doesn't post the grades ever (only on paper) so it's hard to keep track of where you are. But she clearly knows her stuff and answers questions easily.

Dr. Samz is a great professor, she explains the textbook better than the actual book.  Lectures are content heavy, missing class has a lot of making up to do. I struggled with philosophy but Samz made it so much easier! Really good professor. Explained everything in lecture very well when the textbook doesn't. The class is quiz heavy but if you look over your notes and study off of that and doing some of the practice questions you should do well.

Professor Samz is one of those teachers that you are very lucky to get if you don't like homework or doing much out of class. Dr. Samz is a great woman who wants you to succeed. As long as you pay attention during lecture and take notes you'll be fine. Quizzes and tests are all take home, including the midterm and final. I never did any of the reading outside of class, I just listened to what she said or looked over the handout and was fine to write the final paper

Samz is the most straight forward teacher. All you have to do is show up and write everything she puts on the board as that it what the quiz and mid-term will be on. He is awesome! one of the most enthusiastic and educated professors in my four years at nazareth. His lectures are pretty entertaining as he has a lot of interactive slides. I would totally take another class with him.

He is a really great guy. The class is fairly easy and not a lot of work. Weekly forums that really only take 10 minutes to do, 2 papers, and bi weekly quizzes that are open note and on Moodle. He is very funny in class as he teaches. He is real and down to the point but not mean. I would definitely take more classes with him.

Not as bad as the rest of these reviews, super nice. She does make some mistakes sometimes but someone in the class always catches it and she always fixes them. I personally would take her again. The quizzes are not that hard, but if you struggle with math then get a tutor.

She doesn't even know how to teach it, she constantly says she is confused. Random assessments with little notice. She cannot even explain anything so nothing makes sense. If you get more than two problems wrong on a test you will fail. Definitely do not take this class.

This professor was very nice, I like her as a person. However as a teacher she's terrible. This might have been the worst class I have ever taken. She was confused everyday and had no idea how to do basic calc. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS.
Just show up do the work and you'll be fine it's nothing too hard. Prof is really nice and is always available to help you with anything.
Like this teacher and this class a lot so far. This class takes a lot of patience and problem solving skills!
Great instructor overall and creates a very low-stress class environment, also a really easy grader

Islam is one of my favorite professors. What you have to read before every class is laid out in the syllabus and it is very important you read everything. Only three papers that are graded along with attendance and participation in class.

Professor Islam was one of my favorite professors this semester. He assigns readings that are due before class, but he'll usually show a YouTube video on the reading that was assigned. He does call on people randomly to give their input, but if you didn't read you can always comment on the videos that he shows in class. 100% would take again.
He is the easiest teacher ever, a lot of participation is needed because he will just call on you randomly, but if you say something random, it works for him. Great guy and teacher.
He is super chill and wants you to succeed.

It's a very easy English class. Mr. Islam likes to make his lectures engaging so he's not just standing up at the front. He asks for class discussions where you can discuss your viewpoint with no judgement. I'd 100% take the class again and again if I could. The texts he has us read go along with real world problems in today's time.
Very kind and helpful professor, easy grader, would definitely take his class again.

Professor Islam is so very kind. Ultimately, he just wants his students to engage in his class and enjoy what they're learning about. If you show up to his class, read the assigned readings, and participate, you will get a good grade. We had like 2 essays throughout the year. He was super sweet and always cared about his students.
The professor is a light grader

I don't know how Suhail doesn't have 5 stars out of 5. This guy is genuinely so nice and just wants to hear your thoughts on the things you read/watch outside and inside the class. Professor Islam is great. He's very personable and even though the class can be kind of boring, his humor and comments always lightens the mood. Dr. Islam is a very kind and caring professor. The class and the readings are quite boring, but you need to read because its entirely discussion based. Very few lectures. All we do every class is have a discussion about the readings from the night before and occasionally we would watch videos. He is a very sweet professor and you can tell that he cares about his students and loves what he does.

Absolute sweetheart.  He's so nice, but sometimes too nice.  a few people in my class like to ramble on about things that aren't related and he's too nice to stop them.  I would rather hear him talking than what the other students did the other day.  He is a slow grader, but nonetheless he does care.  Lots of reading & talking in class so be aware.
this man is literally so nice he's like a dad and although i didnt always like the class he made it better :) he is a very slow grader though, only con. BUT HES SO NICE
He's so nice he's like a dad. The class I took was boring and it can be hard to understand him but he's so nice.

Be prepared to read but besides that this course is so laid back. sometimes there were journals at the end of the week other times we didnt have them. 3 papers total and he cancelled our final presentation cause we were stressed. you really dont even have to read you can just bs a response when he calls on you and you will be fine

Professor Islam is the best!! There are readings but you don't really have to do them you can make them up as you go. There are always class discussions but they are really laid back don't stress it. He canceled our oral presentations and pushed back the final paper due date because of how stressed we are. There are only 3 papers.
He is a pretty laid back teacher. He may not be the best, but he is very caring and understanding. Would do anything for his students.

He is so caring, he cancelled our final paper because so many people told him that they were stressed out. I never read the reading before class and was able to write journals and the 2 papers just off of class discussion. Participate to the discussion once per class and you'll be fine. Dr. Islam cares SO much about his students. He is incredibly understanding about difficulties that can sometimes get in the way of academia (i.e. a global pandemic) and he doesnt dock grades for it. Dr. Islam is a very kind man and he makes it hard to not dread this class. He wants to see his students succeed. The books are incredibly boring. You write 3 papers, no final exam. Great professor!! There is a lot of reading and journals for every class, but most of the reading is actually pretty interesting. Discussion based class with two papers and a group presentation. Very funny and caring guy who cares about student success and values diversity. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Islam is seriously one of the most incredible professors that I have ever had. He made me feel that I have true potential within my major and truly cares about the well-being of his students. He is such an inspirational person and genuinely wants his students to obtain knowledge, tolerance, and understanding within his classroom.
He makes us write journals for each class

comment: Dr. Islam is such an amazing guy, he is hilarious and genuinely cares about the students and the topics we cover in class. We only write 2 papers in this class and the final paper you are allowed to expand on one of the first two. This class is the easiest English class I have ever taken, we either have conversations about books or watch a movie.

Majority of classes are spent doing group discussion so be prepared to talk. Never gives above a B+ on essays no matter how hard you work on them. Bad at replying to emails and scheduling office visits so if you need to talk outside of class you're out of luck. Very nice man, passionate about his job.

Always too many readings assigned for homework and he never actually reads his student's papers and everyone always just gets a B or a B+. Basically impossible to get above a B+ because he rarely gives out A's.

He is a very nice man and the class is easy to slack in. That's about it.  He is confusing and doesn't know what he wants from us.  I heard he gave everyone a B+, which is unfair, because I know I did much more work than some of those people and feel I deserved higher.  He also gave everyone the same essay feedback - "use more examples"
Easiest professor I've ever had.  If you go to class and write the two essays that he assigns, you will get an A. Great GPA booster.
He is a REALLY NICE GUY and down to earth! The class is easy..just participate in class discussions and you will get an A!

Terrible. Probably the worst professor I have had at Nazareth. He is extremely disorganized and clueless. He will give you a syllabus, but won't follow it after the first few weeks. You don't have to do any work to get by in the class, which is extremely annoying because we're paying thousands of dollars to go here. Big thumbs down for this guy.
Passionate & engaging.  If you have interest & are actually looking to learn something interesting this is the guy.  If you are not he probably won't mind.

he is a very nice guy and a very easy grader. but i feel like i've been gipped out of an actual class. he did not give us a full schedule at the beginning of the class or at all for that matter. So the next book you end up reading is a surprise until he emails you sunday night with it and the 100 page reading is due on tuesday.
Really relaxed, easy grader, and very funny.
Easiest A ever. He does not even notice what you do at all. You don't have to do any work. As long as you occasionally say something in class its fine.
Dr. Islam is very passionate about his work, he is an easy grader and loves when you participate, even if it is off topic! Great Guy.
I loved class with Dr. Islam. The class I took with him was a night class, so that made it a little hard to take. If I had it with any other prof., I most likely would have fallen asleep though.
Great Teacher...Definitely recommend him for any class.  He grades very easy and is willing to change the silibus if something happens.
Dr. Islam is awesome. he is super nice andreally cares about his students
The above comments are all totally valid and accurate; Dr. Islam is a fantastic professor and he knows a lot. He truly cares about his students

He rocks! I am trying to get him as my professor next semester. I recommend him to everyone. He is funny, practical, and really truly cares how you are doing in his class whether you have a C+ or an A.
Interesting teacher, cares a lot about how you do in his class.  Not necessarily the grade you are getting, but how much you are learning.  Very cultured.  i recommend taking any class with him
This man is so interesting and knowledgable.  He has a great heart and is so peaceful and adorable.  Good sense of humor, very insightful.  Great class but a lot of writing.  It is worth it though.

Entire course was group work projects; I got stuck with a bad group (luck of the draw). Thankfully projects were easy and so were tests. Amazing at lecture, very interactive, great feedback on presentations. Let me crochet while he lectured so that was nice. Overall great guy, funny, and enjoyable professor.

I had Professor Adams for four different marketing classes. He makes every class interesting and ties in real world marketing events. Everything I learned in his classes helped me in higher level marketing classes. He's really funny too. If you show up and put in the work, you will gain invaluable knowledge from him and have a great time!

At the top of the semester Prof Adams seemed super kind and respectful, and I was ready for his class. However, as the semester continued, he let his true colors show. He became very smug and honestly disrespectful at times. I saw another review on here using the word 'Bully' to describe him, and I 100% agree.
Great professor! Career focused and helpful. At times, holds us to accountability, but never disrepectful. Group work is a must.

Professor Adams is a great teacher and is very knowledgeable about class content. However, he can be very rude to the class and comes off as a bully sometimes. He can be hard to work with and acts cocky. I really liked the projects and presentations, but his demeanor and attitude ultimately ruined my experience in the class. Class isn't too hard.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: Bryan is a great professor. He is very knowledgeable and gives a lot of valuable information. I love how a lot of his projects reflect what the real world of marketing is like. He really likes doing group projects, which can be rough if someone is not pulling their weight. He is always available outside of class and is very understanding

Had him for Drawing 2! Always gave good feedback. We did 5 projects which is a lot, but the final project we had a ton of creative freedom. You likely WILL have to come in outside of class to finish the still lifes. Learned colored pencils, pastels & figure drawing. Very well rounded course and taught us a lot about proportions & color theory!

Stefan is amazing at what he does, gives amazing feedback and cares about his students. Always has great artistic advice and an overall kind guy. Gives out other hw assignments(not too many) so the 3-4 drawing projects are not the only thing graded. Grading was a little unclear, but if you put the time and effort into your craft, you'll be fine!

I would give my left kidney to Stephan. He was absolutely incredible, always giving feedback to help us improve, but never making us feel bad about our work. We could always resubmit a piece if we didn't like the grade we got at critique. He was also very funny to be around and understanding and kind.
grading is hard, but split in projects, attendance, and exercises. the final project you get to pick which is nice. This is my 2nd with zoller, and I like him. good painter.

Explaining how he is going to grade something is almost never talked about and he also grades so unfairly. He literally grades practice exercises and if your proportions aren't perfect, good luck on even getting a 90. Only 100s (2) I ever received in his ART class were on projects that were graded based on participation/inclusion of all parts.

Shelly is one of the best professors I've had in my entire VCD degree. She gives interesting projects, good feedback, and is open to all styles of design. She will really push you to do your best, but it will prepare you for the professional design world. Projects are for the most part interesting but may require lots of work outside of class.

Made my life easier in VCD. Helps students who are not tech savvy become tech savvy, simple instructions and great curriculum that slowly builds on your skills.

A kind, caring, and inspirational professor and designer who wants to see your unique art style.

Shelly is a great professor. She knows her stuff and helped each student one on one to work out their projects. For type 1, we had a font of the week and then a quiz about them all at the end, but if you kept up it was easy. All the things she said were helpful to design in general, and she was really fun as a person.

She's super nice and chill, she calls you out if you're being disruptive which I enjoyed. Her assignments are easy and are usually opinion based writing. She likes in class conversations and discussions, and does a few hands on activities

Professor Pritchard was easily my favorite professor all semester! She is easy going & truly cares about her students well being. The class was extremely easy, & she always gave great feedback to all assignments. Assignments were fun & not too difficult. She's so kind & genuine, and will help you with anything you need! Wonderful teacher & person!!

Such a caring and helpful teacher! Her lectures are easy to follow and she teaches english very well. There are assignments due every class but they are usually pretty easy if you just stay on top of it.
She is so sweet and always makes sure students understand what is expected of them. Her class moves fast and doesn't drag, with many chances to raise your grade if needed.

Norah Pritchard is the sweetest human. I would 10000% reccommend her to anyone taking ENG101 or 102. There is little homework and she's very flexible. There are three "big" papers (only about three pages each) but she walks you through every step and you always get time to work on it in class! Loved, loved, loved this class!!!

One of the best teachers I have ever had. Decent amount of reading of short articles or speeches that will be used for future writing assignments but nothing absurd. She is super helpful and understanding. Assignments build on each and feed your confidence throughout the semester. Do your work, show up and participate you will love her class.

Norah is great! She is very clear about her expectations for assignments. Homework dies down over the semester starting at maybe once a week. Essays are short, at most 3 pages. She does writer workshop days before essays are due, allowing students to work and she offers 1 on 1 conferencing for any questions or help on the essay.

She treats all of her students like they're her children, genuinely a kind and loving person. She makes you feel like your thoughts and ideas matter, and she ensures your voice is heard. I wish I could take all of my classes with her. Definitely take her class, it's a breeze and a fun time.
Great Professor, nice class discussions and goes over the homework, no tests but it takes a while to get grades back

Try not to walk into this class taking things personally. She is really sweet, but will absolutely demolish you with no mercy when assessing your counterpoint in front of the entire class. For the same reason, avoid angering her. Otherwise, she's pretty cool. A lot of people really like her. I think she's alright.

I love this woman. She will come help you specifically if she knows if you are struggling and is constantly open to explaining things. She understands how hard Music Theory is and she takes you through every step of the way. As long as you show up, you should do fine in this class.

Holmquest manages to make theory, something terrifying to me, easy. She explains everything in a simple and straightforward way and provides resources to help you get a better grip on the challenging parts of the course. The class can get a bit boring at times... just a bit. The worksheets are pass/fail, so just complete it and you'll get an A!!
Worksheets for each class but not often graded. Very nice and very knowledgeable. Not the most interesting class or attention-grabbing lectures.
