comment: This professor is incredibly passionate about what she teaches and enjoys sharing that passion with her students. She is fun and energetic, and is always engaging with the students. I certainly developed a lot of musical skill in her class. I'm definitely taking her again as much as possible.
Professor is great! The course material is just difficult, I recommend tutoring!

Reef gets mixed reviews, but honestly, he is the best theory teacher I've ever had. Theory does not come easy to me- and Reef has always been available to help me if I have a question. The class is only hard if you allow it to be, meaning, if you don't ask for help when you need it. Also, he is freaking hilarious.

I just finished my second semester of Music Theory of 4 and I can not wait for it to be over. I always end up just passing the course and it makes me miserable having to go into that room twice a week. Prof. Reef is a very good professor but I believe he is way to smart to be teaching first-year students.
I really really liked Dr. Reef. I am AWFUL at music theory, but he always helped me and was understanding. His dog is the cutest and comes to theory review. One of my fav professors at Naz so far.
Dr. Reef has the best dog ever. Will bring to review sessions if you plead. Makes theory more fun, he designs exquisite quizzes and at one point he canceled our final exam because he was in China.
He's just a kind silly guy, super chill

Genuinely ones of my favorite professors of all time. Love this man. Really wants you to learn and succeed, is so funny, indulges us in our gossip but gets us on track and ready to learn. If me or my classmates had any money we'd make him an end-of-year gift basket.

Professor Klumpp is so fun and is a great energy especially for my early class. He is a great guitar player and teacher and the pace he teaches the course at is great. He covers a great range of skills and is super chill when it comes to grading. I recommend taking this class if you want to learn some guitar basics, be able to read sheet music.

Django is a really flexible and knowledgeable professor. He is great at teaching because he will adapt his lessons in the direction of the student's interests and allows room for creativity, while still making sure that you develop a strong foundational skillset. Easy 10/10 professor.
He is really nice! Everyone should take his classes!

Nancy is a very nice lady and makes class VERY entertaining- you will never be bored. She will call on people and ask questions. Class was very easy and had minimal work outside of class, other than the 3 essays.

absolute sweetheart! can be misconstrued as rude, but please take the time to get to know her. such an easy class overall. she WILL call on you for open discussions. if you're nice to her, she's nice to you!

Dr. O'Donnell is absolutely amazing!! I took two classes with her ENGW 101 and 102. She is one of the kindest person I've ever met, super helpful and only wants the best for her students.  ALWAYS participate in class discussions, ask questions, do your homework and don't use electronics and she will be happy with you.

She does tend to get very paranoid and discusses uncomfortable topics in class, she is very inclusive in class discussions even when students feel uncomfortable. And is willing to also learn from her students.
Nancy is very helpful and is a professor who is easy to understand as well as being there for students when they need help, is clear with instructions and what needs to be done for all the essays.
I LOVEE HER! I am taking her class for second semester thats how much I love her and her class. She makes learning fun. If you can't take sarcasm and you get offended easily, don't take her class.
Shes pretty disorganized but is extremely biased. Only gives you essay assignments on extremely liberal topics. She will be on your butt about phones and laptop usage but she is caring.
She was wonderful! By having everyone participate, it was easy to stay attentive. She grades on the harder end but you are able to make corrections in your essay! Her feedback is great.

Professor O'Donnell is a pretty solid choice. She is extremely understanding and is willing to extend deadlines and work with her students, but can be disorganized at times. She provides excellent feedback on papers and makes herself easily accessible for help. I highly recommend taking a class with her.

Couldn't have asked for a better professor for this course. It is hard, but his method of explaining simplifies complex subjects. Even if you don't get it in lecture or miss parts of lecture, he has lecture videos. Always checks on everyone to make sure they understand the concepts, and goes out of his way to help if you let him know you need it.
He is the GOAT. Physics at 6pm sucks… he knows that all to well. He is a high school teacher so he actually can teach really well. If you need physics and or a peq or an easy A, take it with Baker.
He's so amazing

I love Baker! He makes physics so easy made a 6-8pm class enjoyable. Pretty easy grader overall and generous with partial credit. Also so understanding and kind. If you can get him for physics - DO IT.

Such a great professor. He cares about his students and wants to see them succeed. Always available for students to ask questions. Made a 2 hour physics lecture fun and engaging. Highly recommend taking physics with him!
Really fun guy that made 2 hour classes enjoyable and worth going to. I like his style of teaching. Really kind and works with students.

Honestly the best to take BIO210L and 211L with. He gives a bunch of extra credit where it is due and is a very fair grader. He is a light grader on the lab assignments and will always help you with labeling in class if youre unsure about something on the lab assignment. Always accessible by email even tho he is an adjunct and not on campus alot

Mack is a really nice guy and a good professor. Vonica makes the tests and quizzes, but Mack reads over them and will take anything out that he think's is unreasonable. He's a very generous grader and will try to get you the most points that he can. Lectures are boring, but the class is really just memorization. Hard course made easier by Mack!

He was okay. I felt like he could have been more knowledgeable on things. He wasn't a tough grader which was good when it came to lab assignments. Lectures were really boring and not helpful because he would just stand in front of the smartboard and read off the slides. I think taking lab with Vonica is best since he makes all of the tests.

he's an adjunct so doesn't always know what's going on, teaches the material without knowing what will actually be on the test (created by a different prof), does try to give extra help if he thinks the test isn't fair, came in a couple of times for extra help in the lab, nice guy, maybe not the most knowledgeable ever but he does fine.

Do not expect for him to give you a 100. Meeting the criteria he gives will often result in a 90, and you kinda just have to guess what to do for that last 10%. If you are someone who cannot learn on their own from a textbook then this professor is not for you since his classes usually require you to already know the materials.

Professor Gerald Zappia was a great professor. This course was pretty easy, as long as you communicate accordingly with your group. I definitely recommend taking this course with Gerald Zappia. You learn a lot and it is a pretty relaxed course.

comment: Zappia ive learned so much from and if you have questions about the marketing field def ask him! His classes are a little hard but if you pay attention it gets easier. He likes his group projects for sure and a pretty funny guy.
Zappia is a really cool guy, he has you write papers mostly and a few tests here and there. He's been at Naz for a while and earned it. You'll definitely learn something from him.

Hope you like pediatrics because that's the only setting that exists here. Adult rehab? Never heard of her! Ask a question and get a sigh, a riddle, or a stare making you regret your question. Feedback is vague, grading is brutal, and clarity is a myth. Quizzes are typically 7-10 long answer questions with 10-15 minutes to do them!

Nice lady but bad at teaching. You can tell everyone was struggling and she still didn't do anything to change the way she was teaching to help the students. Quizzes were not the same as the work or homework we would have. The website we used to do the homework on called smart work was very hard to use.

Professor Craig does not show an appropriate understanding of the course content. As a lab professor, she will change your final project experiment, not tell you, and then not explain how to do it. She will expect you to already know everything before entering the class.
tags: ['Tough grader', 'Lots of homework', 'Graded by few things']

comment: She gives out weekly quizzes and the time limit for them is between 10-15 minutes, which is not a lot of time depending on the severity of the questions. There are quiz retakes every couple of weeks that can make up for it. She teaches like you already know what is going on. If you have a question, she does not give a straight forward answer.

When I attend her office hours, I often feel talked down to. Her tone can come across as dismissive and condescending, which makes it uncomfortable to ask questions or seek help. I've gone to her for support, but I usually get more out of teaching myself.

She wants everyone to exceed and is very available outside of class. There's quizzes every week but it'll help you with the final (which is all multiple choice). The aleks homeworks are annoying but just go see her for help. You have to do the worksheets/go to workshops since she puts some of the same questions from those on the quizzes.

I think Dr. Hutchinson is passionate about science, BUT this class is unnecessarily difficult for a PEQ. Almost weekly quizzes, which were hard. The lab was built into the class, which was nice.  Getting a good grade is hard. I found myself working harder for this 100-level science class than I did for my history classes.

This course was taken as a PEQ. It was good in the respect that there was not a separate lab class however the workload for this course was a lot. Most of the work is busy work and did not add to my learning. There are quiz retakes. The textbook is optional but it is not made clear on the syllabus.

I think Dr. Hutchinson-Anderson is a lovely lady and a great teacher, but I was not too fond of the class because it was too much work for a PEQ. There were extremely difficult quizzes almost every week. I found myself working harder in this 101 class than I do in my three-hundred-level history classes.

Dr. Hutchinson-Anderson tries her best. She has a flipped classroom which I am not a big fan of, but really does make herself available to meet for extra help. There's a quiz almost every class and the grading is really whack, but she uses most questions from in-class worksheets.

Dr. Hutchinson is very nice and loves science but she seems like she would be a better elementary teacher. She walks around and looks over your shoulder when you're working/taking a test and babies you. She puts up dividers between people like you're in 1st grade when taking a test and it's a little frustrating being treated like a kid in college.

comment: This is the hardest/heaviest work load of a 101 level course I've ever taken and it's so stressful. I love her as a teacher/person, but she just assigns WAY TOO MUCH WORK! So many labs and discoveries, tests are once a week and they're hard, you have a midterm, final, have to present at CARS, have to do multiple final projects and service learning!

I loved her she made it really easy to pass. she goes out of her way to help you better understand something and will usually hold review sessions for tests if you ask. Also i know workshop isn't worth any credits but you have to go and its most of the time worth it
Tries to be sarcastic as if i didnt notice. I dropped this class. I had no idea what i was doing hopefully i dont have to get her the next time i take it.
Great professor. Class is 3 hours long but it flew by. Easily my favorite professor of this semester.
She can come off a bit strict, but she is very helpful. Class is 3 hours long,but it flies by. Very nice, and the homework isnt bad at all

This class was very engaging and we used up the whole time. She would go over most days but that's only because it is a one day a week class. Did not give a chance for revision of an assignment but she graded fair. Class could have been shorter like the others.
Pretty good teacher, She really helped me through a lot of labs and even the final. She can come off as very strict though!
Easily the best education professor I had yet- class is almost 3 hours long and it flies by. Very engaging. She asks thought provoking questions and makes the matterial matter. Great professor.

Extremely mean professor (Dr).  Her tests are way too long for 50 minutes and she has no respect for her students.  She emphasizes group work and does not help with the group dynamics.  She is just a miserable rude person and should not be teaching.

I had her for Math & Fiber Arts and unless your a girl or gay, she will be rude and unhelpful with anything you ask her. There's quizzes every Thursday and you only get 10 minutes no matter the length. Prepare yourself for hours of homework every week due to the weavings and studying for the quizzes. She sounds nice but it's fake.

LOVED Dr. Lewis. The math in this class was very easy and the projects were super fun. You do not have to come in with any knowledge of fiber arts as she will take time in and out of class to demonstrate until you get it.

I absolutely adore Professor Lewis. Ive never liked math or been that good at it but she made it at lest fun for me. I knew how to knit and crochet before this class so that was easy but I can tell she's not a tough grader as I did make a few mistakes but still got 100s. As well if your having trouble she's more then happy to help!
She is not the worst but not the best. You do not learn anything in class, everything is learned outside the class. She is not a tough grader, definitely is a little sexist.

106 is the fiber arts math class, and I honestly would recommend it if you hate math. You barely have to study for the weekly quizzes or the 2 exams. The actual fiber arts suck and you learn everything from videos. I turned in some REALLY bad pieces and got at least an 80 every time. Shes super enthusiastic which is hard at 9am but is really sweet!

My morning class was a total nightmare. Some call her energetic, but I say she's way overboard, acting like a childish kid—super annoying. Math's tough enough, then we get silly dance sessions to start. Homework's insane, and she doesn't teach a thing. Expects us to self-learn it all and arrive ready. So frustrating—no guidance whatsoever, my god!!

comment: Lots of short assignments which helped prep you for the multi part final project. Only two tests, but weekly quizzes (but four dropped!). She was always willing to explain when someone asked a question, and I know many people who made good use of her office hours. I liked stats with her and thought she was good at explaining difficult concepts.

I love Heather for calc. It is homework-based which can be confusing (you learn math alone, basically), but she is always willing (I only needed help a few times). Then you go over HW in class and can ask questions. Weekly quizzes and exams are pretty easy if you study for at least 30 mins. I loved her joyful spirit and enthusiasm for math!

Heather is very knowledgeable and makes the course content easier to digest. She is always available to answer questions both in and out of class and wants everyone to succeed. The course can be difficult as the lectures are spent completing problems and there is no real lecture material.
This professor makes you teach yourself out of a packet. Calculus is already hard and she made it worse. Wouldn't recommend.
The professor did not teach, she hands you a packet of questions and assigns you then each class
Always available outside of class. Show up and go to office hours and you will for sure have an A. She is super nice and helpful.

comment: She is very nice but can be a tough grader sometimes. Exams are tough but if you do the homework you can pass. She is very approachable and will help you with anything but she can be a bit confusing when she explains things.

Be prepared to teach yourself the entirety of the material. Have to do textbook problems before class, and then you go over them in class as if you are already expected to know what is going on. She is willing to help and has many office hours, but I still found tests extremely difficult and barely related to the review sheet

Calculus can be difficult and I don't think I would have gotten through with anyone else. Dr. Lewis has an open door. The flipped classroom is frustrating but effective. Would do a class with Dr. Lewis again! She is passionate and 100% there for her students. Grading can be tough on exams and hw but fair and participation weighs heavily.
This class is boring no matter who you take it with. Lewis is always able to work with you and help you on the material. Just wish homework wasn't graded so harshly so that it could bump up my grade.

comment: I had Heather for structures which was very challenging material. Heather really knows her stuff and has an inspirational love of math. She will answer whatever questions you have in class, and during her office hours, she is also reasonably decent at answering emails. Study for the tests by reviewing old HWs and book problems and you'll do fine.

comment: If you studied for quizzes you'll do good in the class

She is a fairly good professor. Her exams are fair and they are not too difficult. There are two projects for the class that take up a lot of time. She is not always clear when she explains things and she's a little too peppy for 8 a.m.
She may not have always been the most clear, but she was always available for outside help and encouraged it. All things considered, she is a fantastic teacher.

Had Heather for Calc II, and she was great! She explained everything with great depth and clarity, and answered all questions posed. She extends homework deadlines if we aren't able to cover everything. Heather is always in her office during her posted hours and is available through email to answer any questions. I recommend her class highly!
Not very helpful on work. She is nice and offers helpful, but doesnot committ

i absolutely adore professor lewis. she is always so energetic and enthusiastic about teaching. she never fails to have a smile on her face. her teaching is basic enough for anyone to understand and she will do anything to make sure everyone understands what she's saying. she also offers extremely easy extra credit! (ISN'T THAT AWESOME)
She's very energetic, at all times of the day! She teaches the material well and will gladly help in any way that she can.
She is a fantastic teacher! A bit crazy, but makes the class fun and interesting. She is very helpful and wants all her students to do well.

She is a great professor who tries really hard to help everyone succeed in her classes.  She shows an interest in student's lives and will put as much effort into your education as you put in.  If you try in her class, she will bend over backwards to help you succeed.

Extremely enthusiastic (ISN'T THIS GREAT!?!) and helpful however she focuses a lot on keeping on schedule and she's not about to slow down. Assigns a lot of homework, all math teachers do. Index cards and study guides for tests

Rather crazy at times, teaches barefoot often, and is VERY enthusiastic about math....highly entertaining.  Her stats course was incredibly easy, and obviously thought that as we were not math majors we were horrible at math - let's just say she "taught" us the formula for a line...y=mx+b...i think I learned that in 7th grade.

Great professor! She explains everything in great detail to make sure everyone fully understands concepts. Very approachable and always willing to answer questions even if you think they are stupid ones.
She thoroughly explains everything and never tries to trick you on tests. She is full of energy and tries to make class as fun as possible.
interesting lady. not very helpful. harder class than it seems
very enthusiastic, nice, and willing to help you out, makes me laugh because she is so dorky
She maeks this class fun and is always enthusiastic

She is always interesting to listen to and will often share bits and pieces of background on things you are learning about that you would have never known. She is very enthusiastic and is a great teacher. She'll help you at the snap of a finger. Awesome professor!
Kinda crazy, and VERY enthusiastic about math. Helpful, and very nice. Class was easy.
She is a little different, but she shows enthusiasm for the subject that actually makes the class somewhat entertaining. She is very helpful and willing to go out of her way to help students.
She explains things so that everyone can understand it pretty well...She goes really slow..which gets boring...butyou know what's goin on!
At the start of every class she says  Happy ___day , as in  happy monday   happy tuesday   happy wednesday . So annoying!
Very friendly. He talks a lot but is getting better at not being boring. Workload is also very easy

Professor Ray Martino is a good professor. He gets his points across pretty well and is very lenient on grading. Overall, he is a wonderful person and the class is pretty easy. Overall, I enjoyed his class and he is a very funny man.

Ray is the cutest old man imaginable. You can tell he's passionate about teaching and having students take something away from the course. He did a good job of getting to know everyone in the class, which made the speeches easier. Classes were interesting, but would've been better if the class participated more, but he tried his best.

Ray is great, I really enjoyed his class. He always ended early (it was a once a week night class). Very heavy on the discussions, so as long as you participate you're good. He is super engaging and fun to talk to, as long as you communicate with him you will be fine.
My favorite professor makes lectures so interesting!

Dr Forbes is my favorite professor ever!!! So funny and really cares about her students. The class is info-heavy and the textbook is definitely necessary but she makes it fun and there are study guides before every exam. There's also only one final paper! The only thing is she literally never answers emails but she's accessible during office hours!

I LOVE DR FORBES! This is my second class with her she is the best prof I have had at Naz and abnormal is my favorite class in my psych minor. Main thing you're graded on is exams, so make sure you study but she gives study guides which are SO helpful. There was a textbook but I barely read it so don't worry. Cannot recommend Dr Forbes enough.

I learned so much in this class and Dr. Forbes is not only kind but also very knowledgeable. She shared many personal examples of class content from her time as a therapist, which helped make the class interesting and related the material to real life. I'm not a psychology major but took abnormal psych for fun and had a great time. Highly recommend

Keep class very entertaining and made it go by quickly. Material was fun in her class. Her tests are very fair and she gives a study guide which helps a lot. No homework outside of class except for reading the textbook. However you don't really need the textbook for anything else, it is helpful for the quizzes. I suggest taking a class with her!

Loves her so much! She made psychology fun and easy to understand. I would definitely recommend the textbook because some thing on the tests are not in the lectures. She's very understanding and available for help or to proofread a paper before turning it in. 10/10 high recommend, would love to take again.

Best professor I've ever had! She is clearly passionate about what she teaches. She grades slowly, but always offers that if students visit during her office hours she will skim their exam/paper and give an estimate of their grade. Also, there was nothing from the textbook that she didn't also go over in class so I didn't find it necessary to buy.

ABSOLUTELY AMAZING, the best professor I've ever had! I would recommend every single class she teaches. She does take a long time to grade, especially with papers. But this class was pretty much the only one in my entire life where I have been 100% focused in class and not thinking about other stuff. She is an angel, please take all of her classes!

Dr. Forbes is an angel on earth. She is someone who I want to sit down and have therapy with even though I am mentally not required to receive therapy. Her lessons were interesting, her personality is great, and she is a very fair grader. I had a great time in her class.
Professor Forbes is the nicest professor ever. She gives assignments that help you understand the material and her study guides are PERFECT for the exams. Take her classes!!!!
sweet prof. and very caring and understanding, lover her

She is such an amazing professor and is very thoughtful. In our class, we talked about a lot of sensitive topics, and she made sure everyone knew they could let her know if they got uncomfortable. I would definitely recommend her and hope I get to take another class with her in the future!

Dr. Forbes is awesome! I had her for Intro Psych, and loved her teaching style, so I took Abnormal with her this semester. She explains material thoroughly and gives real-life examples to help you comprehend topics. Tests are fair, and her grading on papers/discussion boards is not harsh at all! Take a class with her if you have an opportunity!

Love Dr. Forbes!!! She is so helpful when it comes to class content, or any other topic you want to talk about with her! 3 tests and 1 final but she tells you everything you need to know. Would definitely take another class with her :)

Prof Forbes is an AMAZING professor. If she taught every PSY class at Naz, I'd take it with her. She ties clinical experience into her lectures and gives you a detailed study guide for what will be on the test, even telling you what stuff is in the textbooks. Go to her lectures and you'll learn 98% of the test material with ease.

AWESOME psych professor. Her study guides tell you exactly what is on the tests. The papers are easy and have clear grading criteria. Also offers extra credit and gives awesome lectures. HIGHLY recommend.

Dr. Forbes is the best professor I've had at Naz. She brings her own personal experience into the classroom, and is always available for both academic and personal needs. Would highly recommend taking a class with her! Tests can be a bit difficult, but she will tell you what you need to know.

She is the BEST professor at Naz by far! If you have an opportunity to take any class she teaches FULL SEND IT!!! But, on a real note... her tests are very fair and the writing assignments are easy and further your learning. She makes learning content interesting and effortless when she ties in her past clinical knowledge. LOVE HER <3

Forbes is an incredible professor! She gives great lectures that you remember for the tests, her powerpoints are clear and helpful, and she ties in her past clinical experience a lot. Only a few short papers and she will work with you to make sure you get the grade you want. Her expectations are clear and she clearly wants her students to succeed

Honestly the BEST professor you'll have. She comes across as demanding during syllabus week, but don't be fooled by the tough professor facade. There are a fair amount of assignments but ALL OF THEM actually do further your understanding of course content. I'm taking another course with her next semester because of how great she is.

LOVE LOVE LOVE Dr Forbes!! Definitely my favorite professor. Her lectures are very clear, thorough, and helpful. She uses much of her clinical background in class which makes it easier to relate to her. She is a fair grader and her tests are very fair. She's not trying to trip you up, but you also have to put in a bit of outside work to get an A.

Courtney is one of the absolute best professors at Naz. She uses much of her own clinical experience to help relate concepts to the real world. Her tests are super easy if you go to class, even though attendance is not mandatory. Very few out of class assignments. By far my favorite class taken- I look forward to it everyday!

This was for her SWK 383 junior internship class. Gem is very kind and well intentioned but her grading is by far the toughest in the social work department. She is always accessible in and outside of class. Participation matters and she will notice if you aren't putting in the effort. Unfortunately, I felt like I was learning the class with her.
Gem is a Gem! She is the sweetest human ever and truly cares for her students. She will always hear you out and make sure you understand the material. I recommend her to everyone!!!!!

Ting always gave helpful advice, examples, and freedom when it came to our makeup designs. A bit unclear as to what grades were based on as there was no rubric or feedback. Blunt in the way of critiques, yet it comes from a place of pointing out improvements that could be made.
Ting is a brutal grader.
Loved her!
Hard grader, but fair. Best teacher in the theatre department.
She is very passionate about the class. Very helpful. Always well prepared. Good class.

She is tough but really knows what she's doing. Class was very interesting and she definitly did NOT favor theatre majors. She does favor students who really try, and will notice that and grade fairly based on that.
Hard grader, but really loves the classes she teaches. She has an accent, but it is no worse than any other teacher with English as their second language.

She definitely likes theatre majors better.  Her accent is also kind of hard to get used to.  The class isn't too hard, though, and she's a fair grader.
Hard to understand, doesn't explain assignments very well, wants everything done her way and if not it is wrong.
If you are not a theatre major.. forget it! She was rude to me and not helpful at all when I asked her questions. I was so happy I only had to take one class with her!
She was very difficult to understand and could care less about you if you are not a theatre major.
Incredible person--if you give her a chance. Hard but fair. Slight accent--GET USED TO IT
Awful accent, couldn't understand a WORD. WAY TOO HIGH OF EXPECTATIONS for non-theatre majors. Yuck.

Lori was a very kind professor. We wrote four essays throughout the semester, and they weren't difficult; they were open-ended assignments that allowed for a lot of creative freedom. Attendance is important because much of the class involves peer reviewing essays, which make up a significant portion of the grade. Overall, it was an easy class.

lori is so sweet. she is very good at returning emails and communicating with you. she also formats the class so you get lots of feedback on your essay before submitting it. the feedback she gives is constructive and helpful. she is an amazing professor.

Prof Huth is a very nice lady but is unclear of what she is looking for in your essays. A lot of group and peer editing is done in class along with learning a few key writing characteristics but none of it is helpful. she explains the purpose of the essay but when you write your draft she'll say none of it is correct and you are doing it wrong lol

Bill is an incredible professor. I learned so much in his Vocal Tech class, especially about both vocal technique and the business side of the arts. I gained a lot of new singing repertoire and truly loved the class. During the first semester, he typically doesn't give A's, so don't be discouraged if you earn a B.

He truly cares about his students. There are reading quizzes and a presentation. Both the midterm and final are hand written. No technology is allowed in class but he keeps his lectures interesting. I always looked forward to going to his class!

Professor Karna is easily my favorite teacher I have ever had. He genuinely cares for his students and will take time to help you in his class. He also is very understanding with the fact we have outside lives and sometimes school can get difficult. I'd recommend him to anyone.

Bishal is genuinely one of the best teachers ive ever had. hes very understanding and accommodating when it comes to students and a simple conversation with him goes a long way in the long run! he preps you for every exam, gives you the questions beforehand and everything is extremely straightforward.

Bishal is the best. Take notes and you will have no issues. I just skimmed most of the readings right before class. He gives you the exam questions beforehand. Prep for each question and you'll be fine. If you're having a hard time understanding a concept just reach out to him, he wants his students to succeed.

I struggled throughout this semester so bad and even missed half of classes (excused absences) He is the most caring prof I've ever met and actually wanted to work with me to get better- health wise and school. I would give him a big hug if I could. All quizzes are online and in the readings. Assignment's are straightforward and easily get a 100
Bishal is a cool guy, but I was often lost in his class. It is all lecture, and we weren't allowed to use technology to take notes. The way he let us prep for exams was great though.

I love Bishal so much. Spiritual care changed my life. Readings were long, but SO worth it and interesting. He is so passionate about his work and extremely caring. As long as you put in effort, he is an easy grader. Reading, lecture, writing, and discussion assignments. Cannot recommend enough, really.
Teaching style is great, a lot of busy work, but his grading isn't too harsh.
nice guy cares what hes teaching but theres a quiz before every class and u should read the book.

comment: Bishal is the sweetest man ever. His class is super lecture heavy and you have to actively take notes to do well. Reading quizzes before every class so textbooks are NECESSARY. No computers or phones allowed. His voice will lull you to sleep.

Not interested in the content so the class was boring, but he's a good teacher. No laptops. Readings with a quiz due each class. Midterm and final questions were given in advance but hand written responses in class. Put in effort for your presentations, he will grill you if you do badly! Sweet, cares about his class. Lectures put you to sleep.

Great guy, went hiking once and saw him out on the trail. Gives a lot of homework. VERY lecture heavy. He's the only reason I'm doing homework during finals week. Also incredibly kind and understanding.

He is the only professors whose lecture you won't fall asleep to. He has a great soothing voice, so if you do, it's not because he is boring, it's because he has a calm voice. He makes his lectures engaging and fun and easy to understand. Lots of assignments and quizzes but comes from easy reads. Overall, 100/10.

Bishal is a great guy and he makes sure to learn everyone's names. This class was way too much work for what it's worth. So many papers and an in-class presentation. Make sure you go to class because he does not post notes and you only get two absences. Overall good class but much more work than my 400-level classes.

Professor Karna is really open to class discussions and what your option or thoughts are on the subject, which makes class that much better. This class really makes you think, but in the best way possible and really makes you question a lot of things. The only downside about this class is the amount of reading (online) quizzesand papers there are.

Prof Karna was incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the class content, however the level of work was arguably a bit much for a 100 level course. But, ALL of it was very clearly explained and assigned plenty of time in advance, and we are all in college, you can write a couple paragraphs. Get a grip.

Bishal is a very friendly and funny professor, but does assign a decent amount of papers. He takes some time to reply to emails. It's a lot of writing. Do not use ChatGPT or your final will be in person instead of online. We had to come in on a Saturday afternoon to take a handwritten final exam. If you do not show up you will not pass.
Idk how I feel about Bishal. If you don't go to class your screwed. He's very nice but a harsh grader in my experience.

He is a super caring guy who is always willing to help his students. The quizzes were all open note and super easy. He likes to look more at the philosophical side of religion sometimes, so I was kinda confused what he was talking about at times. But overall a really easy class

Bishal is really nice, but there are reading quizzes every week (usually around 5-10 pages). One thing bad is that he doesn't allow electronics at all in his class. Every single class is a lecture, but he has a very clam voice so it's not the worst. There's a lot of overlapping assignments and there are lots of lectures. Also he's from Ohio :(

comment: Professor Karna was awesome. His test were reasonable and as long as you do the work it is not difficult to get a good grade.  His class is a little lecture heavy, but his personality is wholesome which does not make the class unbearable.

Extremely boring class but Bishal is the sweetest. All quizzes and tests including the midterm were take home and open note. Quizzes due before every class but they were straight from the textbook (literally fill in the missing word in the sentence from textbook). Extremely understanding and willing to work with you.

Bishal is an amazing professor who truly cares about his students. I enjoyed every second of his class and wish I could take it again. I will be taking more courses with him and can proudly say that this course has changed my entire life.

Professor Karna is very nice. I took his Religion 101 class for my religion PEQ. I didn't care for the topic, but I like him as a person and a professor. His grading methods were clear and the class was fairly easy.  The tests are open book, which is awesome.

Bishal was great. Very passionate about religion and did his best to make class interesting. The "textbook" was the book Tales of Wonder which I actually enjoyed reading. Not too many assignments so definitely a good class/professor to take if you have a heavy schedule.

Bishal... the man, the myth, the absolute legend. Not only is he fine as I don't know what but he is a wonderful person. I highly recommend taking his class. It can be a lot of work at times but I guarantee it will have been worth it. Just treat it like any other class and you'll be alright. Bishal, you will be missed. <3

This man is so fine, he makes religion worth paying attention to just so you can see him stand on his tippy toes. 10/10 recommended sitting through this class and tallying how many times he says does that make sense? Bishal was a pleasure and I will miss his class

Karna is a really chill professor. This class is all online and we never met he would just post echo 360 videos and we would watch them for a grade and then respond to two of the lectures. His quizzes are just to watch a movie and answer 5 questions. The mid-term wasn't hard it's literally just the lecture. A really great guy and understanding.

I have had a few classes with Dr. Karna and every time my life is changed for good. The classes have changed the way I see the world and his passion for the content is evident. He is an old soul with great knowledge and creates an open and safe environment for each student to explore and expand their beings.

Highly recommend taking this course with this professor. He makes the material interesting and engaging. I loved learning about the 5 main religions and I am able to apply what he taught in my daily life. Plus, there are even movie assignments that are fun to watch. Highly recommend taking this course.

Bishal is a very kind and caring professor. Our class was asynchronous online, so it included 4-5 lecture videos each week, a movie with quiz and discussion questions, and a multiple-choice test for each unit. If you pay attention to the lectures, you'll be fine. Very easy class if you put in a little work, and he's a great guy.

Professor Karna was the most amazing Professor Ive ever had. Hes extremely kindhearted and accommodating. His quizzes and tests are not hard as long as you attend the lectures and study a little bit. A textbook wasnt required which was nice too, saved me a couple hundred bucks. 10/10 recommend taking a class with him.

Bishal is a great person but has pretty boring lectures. I have this class all online and he sends us about 2 hours worth of lecture videos a week which I recommend putting in 2X speed. His quizzes are easy and definitely attend the extra credit zooms if he has them. I have had over a 100% in this class throughout the semester, very easy.

So, he isn't a bad person. However I don't think he's a great professor. I had to take it online due to COVID, but his lectures were well over the time they needed to be, and gives you a final VIDEO, PAPER, and TEST. Which I think is honestly a bit excessive...

Bishal just has an amazing sense of calm about him. You can definitely tell he is a Religious studies professor. He explains assignments clearly and grades fairly. He seems to just know a lot about life.
He's a nice enough guy, but a mediocre professor at best.

Bishal is the kindest soul at Nazareth. Took this class as an elective and wasn't particularly excited but I left each class feeling a little more enlightened and more interested in the subject. He cares about his students and takes time to answer questions (this class only had 9 ). He is very knowledgable and is full of stories from his past.

Bishal does not give that much homework. We did four quizzes that were relatively easy if you completed the study guide. Heavy studying was not necessary. The lectures were very interesting. We did have to write a few papers throughout the semester, but they were pretty easy. We did not even have a final, just a 5-page paper to write.

Dr. Karna is so knowledgeable and made this such an interesting class. He hands out study guides before each section so you can keep your notes in order! Theres no comprehensive final exam, instead we wrote a final paper and incorporated all of the religions we learned throughout the semester. Great professor and great class!

Super nice guy but not a great professor. He makes his tests very difficult and short answer heavy. He's also not afraid to destroy your essays if they are not word for word what he said in class. He will use every last second (and more) of class every day.

Was an easy class if you did your work and studied for the quizzes. The course was mostly graded on 4 essays, which were very straightforward. The quizzes are fairly easy and although they account for a short portion of the overall grade they could drop you from an A to an A- if you did the essays well. Other than that great class and great teacher
Dr. Tanaka is an amazing professor. I had him for both Aural Skills I and Rudiments and he was so patient and caring in both classes. I wish I had him again next semester.
He's the best ever, I would recommend him for any class.

Tanaka is a fantastic professor that really cares about the students. He's very good at keeping everyone on the same track regardless of knowledge going into the class. Show up, pay attention, participate, and you'll do really well in his class! A+ Professor
He's a sweet guy, and he really wants you to succeed. Show up and pay attention, and you'll do just fine.

Dr. Tanaka is a very easy going professor. Dictation and sight reading is very easy, and you end up improving so much by the end of the semester. If you show up, put forth effort, this class is a really easy A.

You get out of this class what you give. It is a lot of tough information to digest, and it seems extremely overwhelming, but completely doable. Participation and being mentally present in lecture will be your best friends. Lots of bonus points opportunities, and one on one help is definitely helpful for topics covered.

Dr. Vonica is a very understanding professor, especially if you have a lot of curiosity in biology and medical things since he is actually a Physician (MD).  I really liked how he tried to go out of his way to give me the opportunity to dissect a frog with a facial deformity caused by a condition called Holoprosencephaly, but the tadpoles died.

Great guy, he cares deeply about his students and the content. His classes are very lecture heavy & you're mostly listening. I didn't feel like I learned a lot in this class as I am a visual learner and he mostly just talks at the class. However he gives lots of extra credit and is always willing to meet for extra help or discuss your work.

He is one of the few professors I've had at Naz,who truly cares about his students and makes effort for the students who genuinely care. He has great lecture and also uses his experiences in the different fields to teach the students. I definitely would take another class with him and he is one of the kindest and funniest professors that I have had

This course is a very difficult class. Probably one of the hardest I have ever taken. Dr. Vonica is a very lecture oriented class as anatomy has lots of material. Grading is not clear he takes off points anywhere he can. Exams are extremely difficult. I put in 20 hours or more a week for this class.

Professor vonica is an extreme example of who not to hire at a university. He is extremely disrespectful, rude, degrading, and does not care about the success of his students. To me it's evident that he has no interest in motivating and teaching his students, but instead has other intentions. Never take a class with him. Ever

Degrading to students, speaks down to them and in a sense would be considered a bully. He is very unprofessional and doesn't deserve to work with students. Amazing man. Makes everything funny and very nice. Helpful during lab

Honestly he's not bad the course is just hard regardless of the prof- lectures are hard to understand bc he goes fast and has an accent but the powerpoints are good, quiz each week stinks but helps with overall grade, case studies are easy and good for grades too and mylab adds some extra to the grade BUT PLEASE STUDY HARD FOR THE MUSCLE UNIT

It was not my plan to take A&P with Vonica, but every other section filled up. I ended up being very happy to be in his class. Before each exam, he gives case studies to boost your grade and also drops the lowest quiz grade. His lectures are not boring bc he adds in his own little comments which are quite funny. Definitely take lecture with him!

Anatomy is not easy but Vonica makes you try to get the material as best as possible. I love that he does case study's because that really helps balance out test grades because his test are difficult. He also always puts a few bonus questions on his tests and quizzes. He is always trying to find you extra points to pass.

Vonica was the sweetest and funniest professor that I've had here at Naz. His lab assignments are fairly easy and his tests are exactly what you would expect. He loves to tell stories and make jokes. You definitely won't regret taking his class.

anatomy is SO hard but Vonica adds his own anecdotes and explanations which helps you better understand. he gives quizzes, participation points, case studies, mastering for points in addition to tests which really helps. he's funny, sometimes a little too smart and has a hard time dumbing it down, but overall a really good choice for the class.
Funny guy that relates part of his life story to the class! Lab is really just memorization. He is pretty clear on what is expected.

Be ready to take time to study for this course. It is a tough course, yet once you fully immerse yourself in the material, it becomes fun. The tests require understanding of the material, not just plain memorization. Highly recommend taking this course with Dr. Vonica. His lectures are easy to follow and very helpful.

Dr. Vonica single-handedly helped me be successful. I took Anatomy I with another professor at Naz and struggled immensely. If you have the choice, TAKE ANATOMY WITH VONICA!! All he wants is for his students to do well, and stay in their programs. Includes quizzes, etc., to balance out test scores. If you work for your grade, you will do fine!

Dr. Vonica is a perfect mix of goofy and incredibly caring! The material itself is tough but he is very thorough in explaining things and will throw in funny tangents as needed. He's a fair grader and again just truly cares that his students learn and do well!

This class was super hard and you need to study to do well which I wasn't used to. There are quizzes every week, there are 3 exams overall. He is an amazing grader and wants to see you succeed. He will try his best to not let you fail as long as you put in the effort.

This professor was great - easy grader, funny, and willing to help students. The class was usually very disorganized; he goes on lots of rants and gets easily distracted, which sometimes made it hard to get things done. However, would definitely take one of his classes again, given the option.

Was a great lab teacher to have. Made the class laugh and was always willing to help if we were confused or didn't understand the material. As long as you do the work, he will always give a good grade. Overall, he cares about his students and wants to see them do well in lab.

This class is tough and you need to study to do well. Dr. Vonica is very helpful and is always there to set up a time to meet. By meeting with him and going over assignments he made sure I knew the information and passed this class. Be prepared for quizzes, they can be easy grades. Always do your homework.

Dr. Vonica really is a great guy. The lectures do go fast, but if you do the mastering biology ahead of time it helps. The 3 tests  have a lot of bonus questions which is helpful too. If you need help or want to correct something he always gives you that option. If you do corrections on assignments,  ask for help, and get a tutor you wont fail.

He is a really nice guy and he'll work with you to get the grade that you need, but his teaching isn't the best. His lectures move really fast and it's hard to understand what he's saying most of the time. He's a great person, but I'm not a fan of his teaching.

I dont know if Tajc is human he knows pretty much anything you ask him. Great guy, can seem scary but meet with one on one and is so chill. Great story teller. He can explain orgo to anyone and they get an understanding. I think he is the greatest professor at Naz. Also take Thermodynamics of Drug Design with him! You learn about his post doc work

Dr. Tajc is an amazing professor and shows he truly cares for his students. He explains everything thoroughly and provides worksheets to better understand the topics. The class is very hard and requires a-lot of studying. Quizzes are once a week and they're 3 exams for the class. He sets you up for success and his lectures are amazing.

Tajc is a great prof. He posts lectures online after class, but i still recommend attending. Biggest takeaway, this class builds on concepts that you learn throughout the year, so try your best to keep up or you will get lost. Only 3 unit tests and one is the final (noncumulative). Also, pretty much no hw until the biochem portion of class.
Fantastic professor. Favorite science professor I've had yet at Nazareth. Amazing lectures and great at telling you what information is needed. Sets you up for success!

Dr. Tajc is a great professor, you have a quiz every week based on the workshops. Highly recommended that you go so you get good grates on the quizzes. Lectures are heavy but he makes them fun and not boring. You don't have homework until the second half of the semester and it is pretty easy. Tests are NOT cumulative.

I was so scared for CHM221, but Tajc was awesome! Lectures are engaging and interesting. I recommend printing out the slides to take notes or using an iPad. Quizzes are exactly like workshop - if you go to workshop you will be fine. Three non-cumulative exams each worth 25%, so make sure you study. If you have questions, office hours are helpful!
Amazing Prf!

I did not think I was going to do well in this class, however, he really does make the material easy to understand. He is willing to help you if you need it and the workshops are a necessity if you want to do well in the class.

comment: Lectures can be very confusing, but workshop helps when it comes to applying the material and learning what could be on a test. Quizzes are fair, based on workshop, and he drops the two lowest. Tests are each worth 25%, so definitely study and do the practice test. He is willing to help if you ask or go to office hours

I had him for Organic Chem Lab, and he was one of my better lab teachers. He is very helpful, and is willing to explain things even if it is a stupid question. Will not get mad if you mess up or break something, and is flexible. Solid Teacher.

Organic Biochem is a tough course. What you put in is what you will get out; I learned that the hard way. I put in so much time in this course, and I am thankful for it. Tajc is one of the best professors in Nazareth College. If you have any questions, feel free to go to his office hours. It helps tremendously. There are only a few tests, so study!

Dr Tajc has turned Chem 140- the universal class from hell- into something that is somewhat bearable. The tests and quizzes are hard, yes, but he does anything he can to make sure that you succeed. He's so easy to reach outside of class and will always be glad to help you, or give you outside resources. He also likes to get to know you and ur goals

Awesome professor. I would definitely take a class with him again given the option. This class can be difficult for students who are not strong in chem, but Dr. Tajc will do everything in his power to help you succeed. Although lectures can be confusing sometimes, Dr. Tajc has many office hours and will make appointments if necessary. Great prof.

Dr. Tajc is the man. He is a great teacher and really caring. I had a tough time in this class at the beginning but Dr. Tajc was more than willing to help. Would definitely take a class with this professor again.

Great man.  Drops lowest quiz grade and is a fairly "easy" grader.  Read the textbook outside of class and go to his office with questions you have about the reading.  Going to workshop is extremely helpful when it comes to quizzes and tests.  Strongly recommend for lab AND lecture

Overall he is a good professor, but I learned more in the workshop than the class. I don't think he always explains things well, he is willing to help, but I found the workshop to be very important to doing well. I never used the textbook, but I have heard it explains some concepts better.
Tajc wants to see you do well, and will help you to make sure you do. He is patient, and explains things well in class, and even better in exam reviews. Organic is tough, but Tajc helps.

Dr. Tajc is a very, very good professor. He really cares about all his students and really wants them all to succeed. He is always available to talk to during his office hours. He understands that Organic Chemistry is difficult for many students and will do everything he can to help you understand the material. He is also a very fair grader.

Awesome Prof. very clear in his explanations and will go over something until you get it.  it you pay attention in class you will do well on the quizzes.  Don't bother buying the textbook unless you'll honestly read it.  Hard subject, but he makes it easier!
Great Teacher really helps you understand a really tough subject!

Peter is such an amazing professor!! He is so so caring and super funny! Public speaking is not my favorite thing in the world, but he truly cares about his students and wants you to succeed. He is always willing to work with students takes suggestions them. He does cold call a lot, but if you don't have an answer he's understanding!
He was honestly the kindest professors I've had yet! he honestly cares about his students and is super understanding that public speaking isn't everyones thing but works with them!

I LOVE PETER

He is such a wonderful professor and an even better human being. I learned so much from him not just about public speaking but about so much. He even helped me edit a 5+ page paper for another class since that professor was not as helpful. He went out of his way to help all of his students be successful and feel welcomed.
Peter is great, very understanding and respectful. Great professor to have my first semester of college.
Peter is an amazing professor. He creates a very safe and respectful environment. Peter truly cares about his students and their success, he truly helped me grow as a public speaker!
I loved Peter. He is so kinds and genuinely care about all of his students. he is extremely encouraging and does his best to make everyone feel comfortable speaking in front of the group
understanding and respectful, gives good feedback on speeches in order to improve for next time

Peter (what he prefers to be addressed as) is an incredible professor! He is very knowledgeable in this content area. Gives weekly homework assignments, however, collects them periodically and grades a portion of them at once- WILL give you sufficient time to make sure they're completed. Lenient grader and will adapt curriculum to students' needs.

comment: 3 speeches. Each speech gets more difficult and for the last one you arent suppose to bring anything with you. While that can seem intimidating, he makes you feel extremely prepared, comfortable, and is willing to adjust or talk with you through any of your concerns. One of the nicest professors Ive had!
The class is pretty boring but the professor herself is very kind and cares about her students.

I had her class last year. It was pretty easy, but the class was pretty boring. It is just to get you into a rhythm and to help you know where to find resources for help. It's not awful, just kind of boring. She is a very kind and understanding person. Definitely an easy A if you do the assignments, which are all VERY EASY!!

comment: She comes to class so energized and excited. Hw is not bad at all, syllabus says 6-9 hrs, not nearly this long. All tests are open note, untimed, + unlimited corrections for full credit. She's lenient with late work, grades fast, responds fast to emails, and will meet with you whenever is best for you. I always had fun and learned so much.

I took this class as my math PEQ and it was my most difficult and heavy course all semester. Lots of homework, mandatory group work, and no time to breathe in between assignments. She is a lovely person and so passionate about her job, but dear god the amount of work she assigned caused lots of stress and made the semester overall unbearable

Although Nicole Juersivich gives a lot of homework, and most of it seems to be busy work. I can appreciate her enthusiasm and excitement for teaching. The class will be a lot of work, but her attitude everyday of class is quite nice.

comment: The homework is graded on accuracy not effort, so make sure you're putting forth your best effort. The homework and weekly online quizzes are a lot more difficult than the tests. For the tests, there are clear reviews that are set up just like the test so there's no reason to fail, and you get to bring a 3x5 cheat sheet with you
Not the most effective class I have been to. Could use improvement on teaching methods. Fun teacher though, and a great personality

comment: Does the flipped classroom method, but doesn't do it correctly. She offers little to no help and really makes you work for everything.
Super helpful outside of class, always available during office hours & super willing to make appointments!
Awful. Just Awful. If you have anything to do with her: avoid her.

Every other review is lying. Dr. Alam was my freshman year biology lab professor and I LOVE HER. She comes across as mean but she was so funny and all you have to do is talk to her like a real human being. The only problem is the pre lab quiz can be a little confusing sometimes. Truly a hidden gem at Nazareth once you get to know her.

DO NOT TAKE LAB WITH DR ALAM!! Doesnt know what shes doing, rude, will not answer questions, no feedback, and doesnt not explain the labs just to get mad when you dont understand. Im sorry in advance if you get her...

She was very different with every single student in my lab. But if you are lucky enough to be one of her favorites the class will be very doable, if not you will have to rely on classmates and outside reading to get through lab. If she sees that you are interested in the material she will go above and beyond to help you and get you more interested.

She is the absolute worst, I am so sorry if you have her. She has the worst attitude I've ever seen in a professor and just no respect for students at all. If you ask her a question, 9/10 times she will roll her eyes at you and mummer something under her breath. One called me "stupid white girl" for asking a question.

Not very kind when students ask clarifying questions, she rolled her eyes at a classmate. Didn't start grading until late October which made it difficult to keep submitting work with no feedback to change errors.

Extremely hard labs that were confusing for everyone in the class. Everyone was confused and when asked for help Alam was very passive aggressive. Maybe if it weren't for COVID this class and professor would have been better, but I'm not convinced.

In the class, you will have 3 long papers (Essays), 2 of which are on any topic of your choice, and the other paper is on a biography of an author of your choice. The grading criteria? Nowhere to be seen. For most classes, you'll need to read a short passage and write a 25-50-word reflection on it.

Free class, most is class discussion about the homework that takes 5-20 mins. He doesn't really teach you how to write better papers. His handwriting is awful, and you can't read feedback he gives. No clear grading criteria but is an easy grader overall on the 3 papers and oral presentation.

Professor Naparsteck is such a sweet man. You write three papers and do small assignments for each class, very light work load. He expects everyone to participate in class discussions every class. Overall this was a very easy course to take and I enjoyed Professor Naparstecks wisdom, humor, and advice.

Martin Naparsteck is a great professor. There is homework for every class but they are short and simple. The topics for homework research as based on his interests and enjoy seeing him get excited about students talking about his areas of interest.He isn't a strict grader, only three papers over the semester, and he really wants students to do well

Dr. Naparsteck is a good teacher. In his class you have homework assignments every class, they don't take long at all, maybe 5-10 minutes. You talk about the homework, he calls on everyone, but will take almost anything as credit. Just say what you wrote. You are only graded on the 3 papers you write, and you get to pick what to write about.

Very easy class. 3 papers total. 2 about whatever you want and 1 about a book. All short and easy and easily graded. Lectures are SO boring and you have to participate once each class. Nice guy but class is beyond boring.

At the start, I was a bit confused with the curriculum, but after a week I got the hang of it. We had short 50-100 wrd papers to write for each class correlating with the assignments on the syllabus. Make sure you print these out and hand them in so you don't end up behind. If you show up and complete homework/papers you will do well in this class.

Very easy and laid back class, class is entirely discussion based and pretty boring. courseload isnt bad at all, usually assigned readings and come to class to discuss. he calls on everyone but its an easy credit. one presentation and 3 papers total.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'So many papers', 'Graded by few things']

comment: Professor Naparsteck has been by far my favorite professor. You don't need a textbook or to show up every class as long as you turn in your work eventually. You get assignments every class for homework but they are super easy and only take about 5-10 minutes. I would recommend his 101 and 102 class to anyone.
tags: ['Gives good feedback', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: Easiest class I have ever taken. You have about a 50 word paper every class but they take 10 minutes to research and complete. The class itself is extremely boring so it's hard to want to go. He doesn't grade on attendance, but he does grade on participation. Only 3 long essays which if you do, he basically gives you an A.
Very wise, teaches many lessons outside of class material, daily papers of around 50 words and 3 long papers of topics of your choice was all required for this class. Caring and respectful!

BEST PROFESSOR EVER!!! TAKE WRITING WITH HIM. He is the nicest teacher I have ever had. You can write 3 papers on anything you want. Go have him read your paper before it's due and you are guaranteed an A. I hate English but I LOVED this class.

AMAZING teacher. He is so sweet and cares about everyone. The class is relatively easy and he will read your paper during office hours before it is due and tell you the grade he would give you. Perfect for people who don't love English.

He is the sweetest professor in ALL of Nazareth College. I am a science major so I usually hate English and think it is a huge waste of time, but not in this class! He only assigned 3 papers the whole semester... any topic you want, as short or as long as you want, with as many or as few sources as you want. So easy, no stress. TAKE HIS CLASS!!!!!!
Best English class ever. Professor Naparsteck is one of the most genuine people I have ever met and his class is so easy. I would definitely take this class again.

easiest A i've ever gotten, and he's the kindest professor i've had at naz. He doesn't grade on attendance but he grades on participation, so if you aren't there you can't participate. he lets you write papers on whatever subject you want. the one thing is that his classes are fairly pointless, so it's hard to motivate yourself to go

Mr Caroselli is a really easy professor and super nice! At the end of the semester, we have a final paper, but if you email him and ask him to look over it, he will tell you exactly what you need to do to get a 100. Such a nice guy and his pretty engaging in class too, even tho it can be boring.

The Professor was extremely friendly and open-minded. His Intro to World Music class was so much fun. He kept it very entertaining and made it hands on. It was fun learning about the unique instruments from different countries. Very easy class. Highly recommend!
I love this Professor he is very nice and a great music teacher. Even if you dont know a lot about music he understands and makes class fun.

As a performer, Caroselli is very talented, but as a teacher of world music, I feel like he is not the best person for the job. There have been multiple instances in which he was a bit misinformative about certain cultures (languages, traditions, etc,) and I wish he could have provided more resources representative of those cultures. Not the best.

As long as you show up you'll be fine. We had one quiz the entire semester, and any homework only took 5 minutes to do. The hardest thing is the final paper, but 4 pages really is not that bad in the long run. Easiest music pEQ I've heard of, and playing the ukelele makes it fun. Only thing is he never answers emails

I had to take SWK as an outside of my major class and Professor Banister is amazing. She's super knowledgable and her class is very lowkey and easy. What she teaches is informative and I would recommend her class to anyone. She mostly lectures and we do presentations and some light reading.

Prof B is really nice and genuinely sweet. She loves social work and really understands it. Most of the time you had to show up and on time but she's very understanding. Like most social work classes not a single quiz but mostly presentations or forums.

Jamie is awesome! His ACS section is very discussion based, so make so you do the (extremely minimal) homework so you know what to talk about! He does a very good job at getting new students acclimated to Naz, he's easily the best ACS instructor there is!
Jamie lets the class be mostly discussion based, so be prepared to actually contribute.

Such an amazing teacher. He does not give very much homework, it is just a lot of class discussion. He is a really great person overall and just wants to see his students succeed. I would definitely recommend taking ACS with him!!!

One of the best ACS professors. We used the Enneagram book which I thought was fun to learn about yourself. He cares a lot about his students and would help with any issues, whether related to class or not. A little reading but not that much. He gave out candy each class and made a required class less boring. This class is based on participation.

Gives us candy at the beginning of every class and has even brought in pizza. Very kind and understanding, easy to talk with. Would recommend for anyone needing to take ACS. He does have a lot of class participation activities. Assignments are generally pretty easy.

Best teacher ever. He just teaches the ACS class for freshman and is the Catholic Chaplin and lambda advisor at Naz. If ou ever have any problems dont hesitate to talk to him. So caring and understanding.

Jamie Fazio teaches the freshman fall seminar ACS class. He is very kind and funny, even people who hated the class loved him. He makes students feel at home and you can always go to him to talk about anything on your mind. He is also the Catholic Chaplain and the head of Lambda (LGBTQ+ club). Really great guy!!
BEST MAN EVER

He's not an actual prof. He's the Catholic Chaplin here, but I wish he taught something! this man is spectacular - he is always willing to help you with anything he can. His enthusiasm and spirit are contagious!
nice guy, funny and easy to talk to.

Ron is actually the best! He's funny and engaging and is always trying to push students to be the best they can be. Is very good at coming up with ideas to improve your work and gives very kind and constructive feedback.
Gives great artist advice. Demonstrations are easy to follow along. Sometimes the professor will leave the room for somewhat long and inconsistent periods of time to take a walk.

Ron was one of the best Professors I have ever had. He is caring, intelligent and very descriptive in his explanations and lectures. High understanding of high art verse low art and expects You to be intelligent and dedicated. Loved his class!

Ron’s more laidback approach is a nice balance between some of the more technical art professors. Perhaps his classes are best after you’ve taken a few intro art courses. If you are passionate, and if you are competent in the arts, then you’ll get the most out of his class. I’m excited to take more classes with him in the future.
Best teacher in the WOOOOORRRRRLLLLDDDDD
He changed my views on art forever and I am extremely grateful... I hope to encounter him again...
enjoyable class.
The greatest teacher ever.
Very cool and smart and funny. Also very helpful and kind. His prints are beautiful. A great experience just to be in his class.
I took his art issues class. He is such a cool guy, I couldn't believe his name wasn't on this list.

She is knowledgeable at teaching, and a native German speaker, so overall she's good at teaching German. As long as you show up to class, and give an effort, she will go out of her way to help you increase your grade. She gives a massive of homework, but the homework is extremely easy if you show up to class, there's just a lot of it.

If you show up to class you will do well. She is very accessible and very knowledgeable. If you have a question she will go to length to try to answer it, she ensures that we all know what we are meant to be doing and what she expects from us.
Professor Deir is a great teacher, and is very understanding when it comes to accepting late work. She's very nice and will work with you to make sure you understand what is being taught.
very hard to reach outside of class. Never answers emails

I had her for my Spanish 221 lab. Not her fault, but the lab is extremely pointless. It was just working on Rosetta Stone which I can complete in my dorm room. Birgit Deir herself is a kind lady though. Never talked to her much in class because she does not teach Spanish, but always seemed very cheerful and happy to be there.

I really loved Prof Deir. She is super understanding and kind-hearted. She offered so many opportunities for extra culture learning. She expects a lot out of you, such as many speaking-related activities that can be difficult sometimes. But, she has regular online office hours that are very helpful, and she encourages using the on-campus tutors.
