comment: Is extremely boring to listen to and is somehow pro - AI ?  Despite how much he speaks, he doesn't explain things very well.  What he says in class does not match what he posts in Moodle.  Could be nice, but I couldn't lock in enough to find out.

The first two weeks of this class was a little rough. As an art student, I'm a visual learner, so lecturing me on art principles for 2 hours is not very engaging. BUT! He definitely got better as the semester went on, shortening lectures and allowing more time for work. Overall, he's pleased by most projects and is not very strict on due dates.

I appreciated his passion for the field and desire to teach us things that the university didn't prioritize. He teaches in a way that is engaging for our age group. Lectures are long and sometimes repetitive, but the point he is trying to get across is worth it.

I personally did not vibe with James. Some people say they like him but his class was always a drag for me. He would say we were going to have mostly work time but then lecture on nothing for over half of the class. And critiques took several full 2.5 hour classes.

Getting an A is easy, just show up to class and performances on time, and know the music. He is hilarious, and engaging. He's also blunt, and will correct mistakes. Overall he is a good professor, but he is unintentionally rude at times.

SLP is so sweet, but her lectures are heavy and she over complicates the slides. You do have opportunities to do test corrections and many on the quizzes are online. This semester she dropped half of them (5). Labs and discovery work you will get good grades on, and she is very flexible and will help you make work up if missed or forgotten about!

Dr. SLP is a very caring person, but learning in her class is on your own. Her lectures seem more complex than what the actual material is. I leave class more confused than i was initially. She is great with corrections and make up work, so there is lots of room to make your grade higher. Go to her office and talk to her, she is very supportive.
Gives test corrections for the exams, but they don't help if she doesn't teach anything properly in general. Hoping I don't have to take another class with her.

Take Baker if you don't want to spend hours learning material just to receive the bare minimum of understanding. It gets tiring not having a proper formula sheet, or not having the content properly explained. I can't stress how miserable this class has made me. The practice for quizzes and exams do the bare minimum of benefiting one.

She is a nice person in general, but her teaching style is poor. Lecture doesn't show how to use equations, and leaves little time for labs. Workshop and practices are not beneficial, confusing you more because she does not explain how or why the answer is what it is. This makes it hard to enjoy physics and keep one sane. All I can say is goodluck.

She likes to talk a lot and can get sidetracked easily, but it is so clear that she wants everyone to succeed and does everything she can to make that happen. The class is grades on a lot of things, so even if you don't do well on tests you can succeed. Gives so much practice and offers extra zoom for practice problems to help everyone.

I took this during Covid restrictions. She adapted well. We had prerecorded lectures and in person lecture. Hitting the information twice made the class easy. She gave excessive amounts of optional practice with keys which made studying for exams very clear. We would also go over harder problems in class. Information was conveyed well.

Professor Bedard's class in held in person one a month, the rest of the work you need to do is sent out at the beginning of each week. For homework you answer questions from the textbook or sometimes write a discussion post. Online quizzes every one to two weeks. Final exam is online and you have about a week to submit. Overall a good class!

I love Misti, she is so patient and understanding. She is very accessible after class or via email and is always happy to help clear up any confusion. She makes class fun and a lot less scary than it seems on the syllabus.

I loveeeee misti !!! Very caring and understanding , she will go over asl signs if you dont know just ask and speak up. She corrects you in a kind way and never made me feel embarrassed. Her leture was very long , test were easy if you go to every class.

ASL 1 is a very fun class especially with Misti. If you practice in/outside of class you will succeed. She is very easy to learn from and makes the class easier. She is very kind and will easily repeat signs if you need it. She also gives good feedback to make sure you are doing the correct signing.
Very engaging and caring professor at the UofR now. Practice makes perfect, pay attention in class.

Misti is an AMAZING professor. I learned so much from her and she was so kind and relaxed. I took ASL I and II with Misti. Take a class with her if you have the chance! By its nature, you need to be present to learn ASL, so you can't skip class. However, Misti is super understanding if you need to miss class and will do anything she can to help you

Made very questionable jokes, i felt like she mocked my religion, her lectures were fast and only unimportant info was an her slides. quizzes and test questions were not like what we studied on review sheets. i would not take one of her classes again.

Dempsey made me like religion again:) She is amazingly caring and understanding of her students. She doesn't ask much of students other than participating in class discussions and doing the required assignments. The class isn't hard to pass as long as you do what you are asked to do. If you communicate an issue with her, she will help!

Dr.Corrine Dempsey was one of the best professors I've ever had. She chunks out her content into manageable sections and she structures this course in a very routine way. Every different religion has the same assignments and same structure of 2 days of notes,2 days of online assignments then a quiz. She is super fun and encouraging !
Did not like her at all, was not good at answering questions if you had them and did not give feed back. Would not take a class with her again.

She is such an amazing professor! I really love the way she teaches and find her class very interesting. Her quizzes are kind of hard, but she gives you a lot of other assignments so it does not affect your grade too much. You definitely want to study and put your time in, but she is a great person overall.
Toothe was a great professor! Very engaging professor and even though lecture heavy, kept things interesting. Recently changed her exams to mostly multiple choice exams, and some short responces.
Toothe is a great professor for art history. She is funny, interesting, friendly, relatable and makes her classes/lectures very very fun. Attendance is mandatory - as it is art history.

Professor Viggiani is a great SW professor, I really enjoyed the policy class. She did a great job bringing it to life and tying relevancy into current situations. In a class where some of the information can be difficult to take in, she does a great job with delivery. Totally recommend.
Knowledgable and personable

Pam is  a professor for all the right reasons. At times she can become wrapped up in the ideal world of policy, but overall she is honest and sees the world in its true light. She understands that you won't read if you had a paper due the night before and allows you to bring your laptop to "refresh your memory".
very helpful, down to earth, honest and clear about expectations. great at leading discussions. reasonable about schedules.

Dr. Chacon is a caring and funny person! Class itself is difficult with her, as we are assigned tons of hw that feels like busy work that we never go over in class. She's disorganized -we barely get to any of the material planned. You have to be on top of things to succeed in the class since she cold calls on people to answer questions in Spanish.

Lots of homework was assigned for outside of class to go over in class. However, so much was assigned that we really never got around to going over most of it. She's very nice and is invested in her students' learning, but what we actually learned in class could have been managed better.

comment: Professor Chacon assigns a lot of homework which would be fine if it was actually covered in class. Most of the time, we don't get through even half of the assigned work so it just feels like pointless busy work. She asks you to translate readings line by line which is the worst. She is kind of intimidating even though she is probably a nice person

comment: Chacon was very invested in her teaching but it wasn't straightforward. All of your assignments are online and the class feels pointless because she doesn't teach much. The lab for this class is you working online the whole time. I feel like I didn't learn much either.
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Lots of homework', 'Accessible outside class']

comment: She appears kind in the beginning and acts as if she cares about you and your well being but if you are going through something or need to miss class for any reason she will give you a 0 for that week. She belittles students who don't know everything about Spanish even though a computer program is teaching us. SO rude and makes no accommodations.

She doesnt really give any helpful feedback, nor is she compassionate. She doesnt give people extra accommodations even when they have learning disabilities. She doesnt like hearing feedback from her students. And she called me by my last name most of the first semester I had her.

Hilda is the only full time spanish prof, so you get stuck with her, she uses popsicle sticks to call on ppl so you have to pay attention, the tests are actually kinda hard especially considering we don't really learn anything. If you ask her for clarification she's extremely bad at explaining in different words... super sweet lady tho.

Kind lady who actually cares about her students' health and wellbeing. Class is very grammar heavy, so be prepared. Wish Portales 2 was not so expensive but all the homework is on it :( I thought I wanted to minor in Spanish but I decided not to after this class. Your grammar has to be spot on to do well.

I went into Naz as a Spanish major but quickly realized that I could not stand prof Chacon. She is so standoffish and not personable at all. She was initially so rude to us in class and in emails and thinks that just because she is busy means we are not. I really thought about transferring bc of her, but just ended up switching departments.
tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Participation matters', "Skip class? You won't pass."]

comment: Is not humble at all, and thus likes to remind you of how smart she is all of the time. This makes it very hard to learn from her as she does not seem to care about you, and she loves to take jobs at everything, a byproduct of her background in journalism. Thinks she is fighting a holy mission and exposing the system when she is just a professor

She assigns a ton of readings in every class. She is a really harsh grader on everything and has very high standards. Classes tend to be very repetitive. She has rules for everything all listed in her 20-page syllabus. She also can be really passive-aggressive and unprofessional. But she thinks very highly of herself and makes that well known.
tags: ['Get ready to read', "Skip class? You won't pass.", 'Tough grader']

comment: I have known Dr. Chacon for most of my time at Nazareth. I thought that she was an amazing professor until it was time for me to take my senior comp class. She assigns readings on top of writing the Comp essay. She also canceled class multiple times throughout the semester (atleast 3 weeks worth)
tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes']

comment: Very unclear criteria in general. The syllabus constantly changes and isnt always available. She is disorganized & unclear but expects students to understand, which is frustrating. She tests on things not covered in class. However, she is kind and respectful and cares for her students. Lovely person, not an effective teacher. I was stressed.

She is by far the most hypocritical professor I have had in my undergraduate career. She personally attacks students on their work and participation, which is always unprovoked. She does not take responsibility for her actions when she tells us to be responsible for our own. I did not receive a syllabus until the end of week 4 of this class. Awful
tags: ['Get ready to read', 'Beware of pop quizzes', 'Tough grader']

comment: Dr. Chacon is one of the kindest people I know and cares about her students so deeply. At first, I found her a bit intimidating but quickly realized she has a heart of gold. There is a lot of work assigned but, it is doable and will really help with your Spanish. Just avoid putting all of the work off until the last minute

I will never take a class with her again. She assigns too much homework and in class we do not have time to cover all, even when asked to lessen it she wont. She is a harsh grader and wants things to be in-line with her own beliefs. Reading comprehension quiz everyday that is pass or fail with no comments. She is harsh, combative, and doesnt care.
tags: ['Lots of homework', 'Get ready to read', 'Participation matters']

comment: I had SPN102 and SPN221 with her. Got an A in 102, F in 221. My suggestion is: If you are taking this for your foreign language req. (and you need a sequence of two), take a sequence that is within the same level. i.e. SPN101/SPN102 OR SPN221/SPN222. This class will take up a lot of your outside time, especially if you are non-native speaker.

She is very knowledgable in the subject, but she explains everything in Spanish. She can be rude at times and expects more from you even if you aren't very good at Spanish. Quizzes and tests are hard if you don't study, and the Aventuras homework is the most annoying thing ever. Don't take it with her unless you know what you're doing. Even for 101
She's likes things her way or no way. Her syllabus does not provide a clear representation of the course. No note taking just lecturing. You do the same exact thing each day, nothing changes.

Many group projects in this class. Participation is a must! She makes an extreme effort to help everyone and does not make you feel stupid if you are wrong! So don't be nervous about talking in class.

She truly cares about her students, makes herself available and is a very easy-going professor. Completing homework is crucial to succeeding in this class, especially studying the vocabulary. She offers extra credit a few times per semester, usually for attending a Spanish club event. 10/10 recommend. Possibly the easiest SPN 102 of them all.

HARD!! Quizzes impossible. Midterm Easy. Class time feels pointless. She's a nice teacher don't get me wrong she absolutely loves her students and actually cares which is nice. She is tough grader though and within my class we had 4 kids drop out.

Dr. Chacon is a wonderful person, an extremely intelligent woman and an amazing professor. She loves her job, she cares about her students and she motivates  them with super interesting lessons. On top of this, I love her sense of humor. She is definitely my role model as a woman as well as a professor. In short: Dr. Chacón es la reina de los prof!
STUDY! The quizzes are impossible to pass if you don't.

Dr. Hilda Chacon was an astonishing example of professor. She would help you if you need. She would always joke around in class but never pass the limit. She presents extremely interesting topics and students are required to work with books as well as with videos, songs, documentaries, pictures and if lucky, even live performances.

Great professor, cares about his students success!!!!!!!! Class is useful and not very difficult if you do the homework and go to class.

A god among men.  Should be working at NASA.  Definitely the funniest teacher ever and his classes are super easy and informative.

nice guy can be kinda boring if you ask he'll let you leave class and he's understanding about problems. try to take a class he likes and it'll be more interesting i.e. photography

Amazing professor, very enthusiastic, very intelligent, very helpful. Loved this class and our conversations outside of class. He is absolutely available to help who ever wants his help. Love him!

such a sincere and genuine person!! so incredibly smart but not arrogant at all. he really cares about you as an individual. his discussions are really interesting, so you dont have to force yourself to get involved.

Professor Camp is the best teacher I have ever had. He is a tough but fair grader and makes class so much fun. He has a good sense of humor and will help you whenever you need it. He taught me so much and I am so glad that I took his class.

His class was the best one I took. He's such a cool guy. He's definitely not the easiest grader but going to talk to him in his office hours really helps. He's a really funny guy and his class is worth any sleep lost over the papers. I would love to take another class with him.

Thad is really nice and though his grading is tough, he is very fair at the same time. Lets you re-write papers until you get the grade you want and gives tons of feedback. Very approachable. Only drawback is that his handwriting is horrendous.

You need to work hard for your grade in thad's class. I found myself pulling all nighters to get the work done but if you put in the time, the class is worth it. You learn so much and he makes it as fun as he can for teaching plagiarism and how to write research papers. I highly recommend taking a class with him if you can.
this guy is terrible he is no help and he has a retarded sense of humor he is the worst teacherf ro english i have ever had in my life.
Your brain will explode in not so bad way.

PLUS he's the head of the Writing Center!
Great guy. Take any class you can with him.

Thad is unclear and very unhelpful. I don't think he actually likes teaching and that is very apparent. Don't take his classes if you can help it.

Thaddeus Camp should not teach english. Why does he have to grade so hard?

Thad is definitely hard and expects a lot from students. He is somewhat helpful is you keep bugging him for help. Hes not trying to make you fail, but if you dont try, you will fail. Hes overall a nice guy but definitely a hard teacher

I thought thad was a great teacher... I don't get why everyone thinks he so hard a grader... I get B+s on just about everything and I was never a strong writer in High School, you just have to pay attention and have some common sense. I loved his class

I got assigned randomly to Camp, but I learned a lot. You just have to realize that he doesn't hate you. He just tries to make us better writers.

He is awful. I ended up going to the head of the english department to get out of his class. He doesn't make any sense, and grades ridiculously hard. He expects so much out of you, but doesn't teach you anything!!!

Not the best teacher around. Unclear and confusing. You never know what he wants until after the assignment is handed in. Not recommended.

Love her! She totally gave me the Merton bug and I love the conversation her and I have in class. I just wish students would participate more. READ AND DISCUSS PEOPLE! It's college you're expected to do your work.
Awful. Boring.

i was not a fan of this class. i found dr. pestino to be very unorganized. he w never stuck to what was on the syllabus and never handed back papers until a few weeks or months later. i also found him to show bias and favoritism in the classroom and that reflected in the grading.overall, i found him to be extremely rude and arrogant.

Dr. Pestino is a very nice old man, his grading can be tough when it comes to papers but there isn't much homework for this class.  He's a bit helpful when you bring papers to him (this is mandatory for each paper) but he sometimes contradicts himself after the second time seeing it.
if you miss one over the allowed absences, he will flip out. he gets really angry over nothing and he takes his class wayyyyyy too seriously.

Really helpful and knows what he is doing. Also really nice and funny. Great professor

Dr. Pestino is such a great man! He helped me improve my writing so much during my first semester. His classes are very laid back and very straightforward. He's not like other professors who try to trick you with language. Just watch out - if you don't like to participate this isn't the class for you!
HOT HOT HOT!!!

Joe Pa is a good guy. He is very in-tune with the world today and talks about current events along with the material he covers. Nothing more than a 5 page paper with plenty of time to do it. Will get angry if you disrupt his class though, so watch out.

boring boring boring as a night class
never thought of that ben stien thing...but yeah...sorta boring but he knows his stuff

comment: Comes off strong at first, but after the first couple weeks, it's fine

Mignacca was a very helpful professor and would provide students with MLA citation format for each paper.  In this class, many of the books can be listened to on Youtube and will have an essay assigned for them. Mignacca gives beneficial feedback on essays and promotes pair work on one of the papers based off of your own personal writing level.

As soon as you understand Dr. Mignaccas' sarcasm you will understand she is great professor. I really enjoyed this class and will have her again. She is amazing because she grades your papers will a lot of feedback, lets you revise them and you hand it in again so you can get a good grade. Also, the papers are only 2 pages long.

comment: Dr. Mignacca seemed tough at first, but I ended up loving her at the end of the semester! She's a tough grader but I've learned more about punctuation than any high school teacher ever taught me. I definitely learned a lot from her. She is always there if I need help. I highly recommend taking a class with her.
She is amazing. She is always there for you if you want to talk. She's tough but fair. She wants to see students do well. Just show up and pay attention in class and you should be fine.

Mignacca is a very interesting teacher.  She does seem really tough at first and the class seems pointless and going nowhere, but after a while it'll get better and she is actually a really nice teacher.  She jokes around a lot which makes the class better.  Just listen to her tips and you will get good grades on the papers.

I would recommend to not take a class with this teacher if you aren't up for being confused during the whole lecture.  Her teaching style is all over the place and it is hard to try to understand.  Also, if you don't like being treated like a 5th grader, don't take a class with her.  However, she will try to help you if you need it.

Sometimes she is really interesting and funny. She says some things that really leave me thinking and I like that a lot. I enjoy the material. The papers are hard to understand though, I was extremely lost when she gave out the prompt paper. She is a hard grader but I think it's for a reason. It is kind of disorganized though

At first, I was not a fan.  But, by the end of the semester I realized that Dr. Mignacca was by far my favorite professor! She has a sense of humor and if you acknowledge that she has a reason behind her actions you will get the most out of her classes! I hope to take another class from her.
This teacher was very demanding and wanted a research paper in 4 days. She sounds like a very hard grader but her attiude made me so stressed that I had to drop.

Dr. Mignacca's class was great. Although she is very opinionated and can come off as demanding, she has a great sense of humor and is very understanding. If you are good at grammar, the class is a breeze. Little to no homework

Do not take her class! She is an unfair grader, can never remember what her criteria is for assignments, and refuses to see another person's point of view. She is very inconsistent. She also doesn't understand the rules of punctuation or grammar, and will mark off for things she "feels" are wrong, even if the text for the class states otherwise.

She is very unclear, and she makes things up as she goes. She likes grammar quizzes and made us do a group essay (epic fail). I found that her grading was hard, and her class was frustrating! I wouldn't recommend her to anyone.
She's the best. Love her.

I love Maureen. She's crazy but such a great teacher if you really listen and want to learn. Also, always get to class early, I find it that most days you learn the most by listening to her talk about random things before class starts.
Amazing, lover her to death. Be ready to learn!

Maureen is an extremely genuine and straight up teacher. She won't tell you something is good when it's not, her criticism can be harsh, don't take it to heart, she's honestly just making you a better artist. While taking this class you should have little to no social life outside of the studio. NOT FOR NON-MAJORS!!!

If you come into her class thinking you are amazing, think again. She will make you work your butt off, & when you think you're done, you'll work more. I admit that I was scared crapless of her & had some anxiety, but over time she became nicer & now I love her! If you show progress, she will let loose. Also, note taking is a must! BE PREPARED!!!

She is tough, but fair. If you slack off, she lets you know it. But when you try, and show work, she will help. She believes in self direction. meaning you are the teacher, she will just guide. Her stories are amazing and what you learn works and will stay with you, whether you want it to or not.

Why would someone who's had "master's" courses be taking "ART 101"?  Sounds like somebody is just upset because perhaps they were told the truth about their performance in class.  Will "shy" even cut it in the art world? See previous comment.

She was my most difficult professor of all my college career (undergrad and masters).  I found her rough to deal with as our personalities did not mesh. A Previous Poster mentioned her playing favorites.  I higly suggest getting on her good side and sucking up.  She does not care for the quiet students.  Speak up in her class DO NOT be shy.
She's HOT!

Scared the hell out of me at first, telling us the best way to bite a kneaded eraser and talking about discussions she had with a canadian squirrel, however after a short time I've learned so much. I can honestly say I detest the class but I respect it and value it because I am learning so much.

First semester with Maureen can be tough, she's very strict, but everything she says is knowledgable, and good information. Listen to what she says, do what she says, and life will be good. Don't expect this to be like high school. Must be willing to relearn everything. Don't take criticism on art personally, learn from it and make your art better

The best studio professor I ever had after highschool. The people who think that she is too hard are the lazy people who think they are too good to be taught.  They should just take their work home and hang it on their mother's refrigerator. Don't go if you are not ready to work and swallow your false pride.

Has her pets... is obnoxious...if you aren't one of her favorites WATCH OUT... she is a bit nasty w/ words and very harsh grader- especially if you aren't on her buddy list... I wasn't and it was my ONLY B in four years
takes her anger out on you, if she's having a bad day you will know it! does teach good skills. she plays favorites. good at being honest.
Maureen is amazing.  She will be able to give you the skills and confidence to be successful.  Also, her stories are fantastic.

She is and amazing professor. I learned more from her than any other art teacher I have ever had.  Great sense of humor, loves to joke around but has high standards for students to meet and don't ever be late..  Class with her is a once in a lifetime experience. I wish she wasn't leaving :(

She is awesome!!

Dr. Davio was the worst lab professor I have ever had. A good thing about a course with Morris is he grades by few things so you have an opportunity to focus on your other courses. He has a great sense of humor.. he is always joking around. Pretty funny guy but somewhat of a harsh grader. You don't get many opportunities for an A. The main grades are the two papers and the group project. For the project, after presenting he roasts your entire presentation so he prepared for some harsh criticism.

comment: I took history with Morris, and I learned a ton from him. I will be grateful for the rest of my life for the presentation skills that he taught our class. He is intimidating, but very kind and funny. He treats and talks to his students like real adults.  Nothing but respect for him.

Morris had a good appeal to me because i liked history, but I really hated the fact that the curriculum was based on reading numerous books. On top of that essays were assigned about every week. Hint to the college life!

I loved this class and Mr. Morris! As long as you put in solid effort you will get atleast a B, and if you have any questions or need help with an assignment he will pull great information out of you. I cant wait to take another Morris class! Would recommend to anyone not just history majors.

Loved him so much! Amazing teacher, and would take classes with him over and over again! Very helpful and always has the students best interest in mind. Can't say enough about how much I loved him as a professor!
He is awesome! He is so funny and makes talking to him and class fun. I love his jokes, and is quick to return papers. Can be confusing at times, but is most lenient in the department.

If I had a history class it was with him... he is the most interesting man.  Full of stories and a font of knowledge... I suggest taking the class- he let me write papers based on my OWN major when in was realted to history... it was so interesting... love his classes... five star rating from me... he is a tough cookie though- work hard

he's intimidating but its an act because he's a really nice guy and is pretty funny. expects a lot from students but is a fair grader. chooses interesting texts.

Great teacher...can be kind of intimidating at first, but as long as your honest, and try hard in the class...you'll get a lot out of it.  Definitely learned a lot from him.. good sense of humor, knows his stuff.  Readings for class were challenging, class work takes effort, and definitely GO TO CLASS!

VERY boring.  Class was boring, reading was boring, assignments were boring.  He is slightly funny at times, but not worth taking an entire class for.  If you are only taking it for a PI or PII, don't take it with him!

Ok he is rough, hard grader, and a lot of work, but I feel like I am actually learning something. He definately can work on his clarity of what he wants in a paper though. As for being difficult- at least he is fair and equally difficult accross the board

I loved this class, you'll have to do work to earn your grade but it's worth it, he knows about some much stuff, even if the conversation seems like its getting side tracked he'll have a point

I'll admit i did not like him at the beginning but Paul is one of the best all-around people i have ever known. Very down to earth, helpful, and understanding. I can't wait to take another class with him!

very creative and interesting. i didnt like his style of teaching as much but still an okay teacher.
